66485.recognize_zh: 單顆細胞的核有深切口、形成雙葉相連的「蘋果核」形狀 (apple-core/bilobed nucleus)，細胞質少、帶細小紫紅顆粒，這種核形是急性前骨髓細胞白血病 (APL) 異常前骨髓細胞的線索。
features: Single medium-sized atypical cell, about twice the diameter of a red cell, with high N:C ratio
Nucleus with a deep central cleft producing a bilobed, apple-core/butterfly shape
Finely granular chromatin with a faint possible nucleolus
Thin rim of cytoplasm with fine purplish granules obscuring the nuclear border; no Auer rods seen
Background red cells show mild anisocytosis with occasional elongated forms; no platelets seen
66485.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an atypical mononuclear cell with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and a deeply clefted, bilobed nucleus with an apple-core configuration. The chromatin is fine and the scant cytoplasm contains fine azurophilic granules that partly overlie the nucleus; Auer rods are not seen in this field. Platelets are not identified. Findings are suggestive of an abnormal promyelocyte of acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypogranular pattern) and warrant urgent coagulation assessment and PML::RARA testing.

ddx.vs: Promonocytes have gently folded nuclei with more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and are nonspecific esterase positive with weak or absent MPO, unlike the strongly MPO-positive APL cell.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells and lack a bilobed nucleus with azurophilic granules.
Normal promyelocytes have round to oval eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and coarse primary granules, not a bilobed apple-core nucleus.

66229.recognize_zh: 流式細胞儀圖中，紅色族群在 CD3 對 TCR γδ 圖上形成獨立的 γδ T 細胞群（占淋巴球 27%），且 CD4−、CD8 部分陽性、CD56+、CD16+、CD57 部分陽性，CD5 比正常 αβ T 細胞弱；這是 γδ 型 T-LGL 白血病。注意 γδ T 細胞本來就不表現 TCRβ，故 TRBC1 陰性不能當作單株性證據。
features: CD45 vs SSC gating separates granulocytes, monocytes and lymphocytes; the abnormal population (red) lies in the lymphocyte gate
Distinct TCR gamma-delta positive, surface CD3 bright population comprising 27.07% of lymphocytes, separate from the alpha-beta T cells (brown)
CD4 negative with variable dim-to-bright CD8 expression
CD56 positive, CD16 positive and CD57 partially positive, an NK-like cytotoxic phenotype
TRBC1 negative on the gamma-delta cells, as expected for cells lacking a TCR beta chain
CD2 and CD7 positive; CD5 dimmer than on normal alpha-beta T cells
66229.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis identifies an expanded population of CD45 moderate, low side scatter lymphocytes that are surface CD3 positive and TCR gamma-delta positive, accounting for approximately 27% of lymphocytes. These cells are CD4 negative with variable CD8 expression, express CD56, CD16 and partial CD57, retain CD2 and CD7, and show relatively dim CD5 compared with residual alpha-beta T cells. The cells are TRBC1 negative, which is expected for gamma-delta T cells that lack a TCR beta chain and therefore cannot be used to assess clonality; TRG/TRD PCR or V-delta/V-gamma antibody analysis is required. In the setting of a persistent LGL lymphocytosis, findings are consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia of gamma-delta type.

ddx.vs: Reactive expansions are polyclonal by TRG/TRD PCR or V-delta2 predominant and transient, and phenotype alone cannot exclude them.
HSTCL is also gamma-delta but is usually CD8 and CD57 negative, involves marrow sinusoids with isochromosome 7q, and presents with aggressive hepatosplenomegaly.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-LGLs share CD16/CD56/CD57 expression but are surface CD3 negative and lack TCR gamma-delta.
The more common alpha-beta type is TCR gamma-delta negative, and its clonality can be assessed by TRBC1 restriction.

66165.recognize_zh: 高倍（100x）PAS 染色下，大型細胞有豐富的淡粉紅色細胞質，可見平行的纖維狀條紋（像皺褶的絲綢），核小而偏心、染色質溫和，這就是 Gaucher 細胞；周圍的小圓形深藍核為殘存造血細胞。
features: Large polygonal cells with abundant pale pink PAS-positive cytoplasm showing fine parallel fibrillary striations
Small, round to oval, eccentric nuclei with bland chromatin and small nucleoli
Occasional cells with clear cytoplasmic spaces or retraction artifact
Cells arranged in a cohesive-appearing sheet with distinct cell borders
Admixed small hematopoietic cells with dark round nuclei
66165.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow trephine section stained with PAS shows sheets of large histiocytic cells with abundant pale pink PAS-positive cytoplasm containing fine parallel fibrillary striations and small eccentric bland nuclei. Residual small hematopoietic cells are interspersed. No hemophagocytosis, organisms or nuclear atypia is identified. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells, whose cytoplasmic glucocerebroside accumulation is PAS positive and diastase resistant.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells have similar striated PAS-positive cytoplasm and are distinguished by the associated CML, myeloma or thalassemia and normal enzyme activity.
MAC histiocytes have striated-appearing cytoplasm but contain numerous acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Niemann-Pick cells show evenly vacuolated foamy cytoplasm with weaker PAS staining rather than fibrillary striations.
Crystal-storing histiocytes contain eosinophilic immunoglobulin crystals and associate with a clonal plasma cell or B-cell neoplasm with light chain restriction.

65973.recognize_zh: 周邊血中大量中等大小、染色質粗塊狀的淋巴細胞，部分核較大呈 prolymphocytoid；流式細胞儀顯示 CD19+ B 細胞 99.3% κ 限制、CD34+ 母細胞僅 0.01%，說明這些含類 Auer 桿狀體的細胞是 B 淋巴球而非骨髓母細胞。
features: Panel A: intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with clumped chromatin, round to slightly irregular nuclei and moderate pale blue cytoplasm; some prolymphocytoid forms
Panel B: MPO cytochemistry with the atypical lymphoid cells MPO negative; one granulocyte shows dark MPO-positive granules as an internal control
Rod-like cytoplasmic inclusions are not clearly resolvable at this image resolution
Panel C: CD19+/CD20+ B cells with kappa light chain restriction (99.3% kappa vs 1.0% lambda)
Panel D: CD34+ events 0.01% of nucleated cells, indicating no increase in myeloblasts
65973.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an absolute lymphocytosis composed predominantly of intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with clumped chromatin and moderate pale cytoplasm, including increased prolymphocytoid forms. Cytoplasmic Auer rod-like inclusions described in these cells are not clearly resolvable at this image resolution, but the lymphoid cells are negative for myeloperoxidase, with a neighboring granulocyte serving as a positive internal control. Flow cytometry shows a B-cell population with kappa light chain restriction and no increase in CD34-positive blasts. Findings are consistent with an atypical CLL/low-grade B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder with MPO-negative Auer rod-like inclusions, not acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: True Auer rods are MPO positive and occur in CD34/CD117-positive blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli, whereas these inclusions are MPO negative in mature clonal B cells.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes are medium-large with a single prominent central nucleolus; >55% prolymphocytes defines B-PLL (WHO-HAEM4), which is separated by prolymphocyte counting.
MCL cells have irregular nuclei and are CD5+ but CD23-/CD200-, cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive with t(11;14).

ddx.dx: Plasma cell neoplasm with crystalline inclusions
ddx.vs: Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof and CD138/CD38 bright expression with cytoplasmic light chain restriction and lack CD19/CD20.

64949.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一群成熟漿細胞聚集：核偏位、染色質呈車輪狀、細胞質深藍並有核旁淡染區（hof），周圍混有小淋巴球與漿細胞樣淋巴球，背景為淡藍色蛋白質沉積，符合伴漿細胞分化的淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤（LPL）。
features: Cluster of mature plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and clumped clock-face chromatin
Deep blue cytoplasm with perinuclear hof; no nucleoli or binucleation
Admixed small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Occasional granulocyte with segmented nucleus
Pale blue proteinaceous background with poorly spread, refractile red cells
64949.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of mature-appearing plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse clock-face chromatin, abundant deep blue cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs. Small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes are admixed, and the background shows a pale blue proteinaceous film with poorly spread red cells, suggesting a high serum protein content. The plasma cells lack overt atypia. In the setting of a monoclonal IgM paraprotein, findings are consistent with involvement by lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation.

ddx.vs: Myeloma shows sheets of plasma cells, often with atypia, without the accompanying clonal small lymphocyte and plasmacytoid lymphocyte spectrum; MYD88 L265P favors LPL.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; MZL usually lacks MYD88 L265P and has different sites of involvement.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic by kappa/lambda staining and are not accompanied by a clonal B-cell population.
MGUS lacks a clonal lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate in the marrow.

65653.recognize_zh: 視野中有兩顆嗜中性球：右上那顆核分成約 5–6 個小葉並呈環狀排列，左側那顆約 4–5 葉且顆粒較粗；兩顆細胞大小正常，分葉數增加即為分葉過多的線索。
features: Two mature neutrophils of normal size
Right cell with about 5-6 small nuclear lobes arranged in a loose ring
Left cell with 4-5 lobes and somewhat coarser, more prominent cytoplasmic granules
Condensed mature chromatin; no Döhle bodies or vacuoles clearly seen
Normocytic red cells and scattered platelets in background
65653.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature neutrophils with increased nuclear lobation: one cell has approximately five to six lobes arranged in a ring-like configuration, and the other has four to five lobes. The left cell shows somewhat coarse cytoplasmic granules, which may reflect mild toxic granulation in the setting of recent infection. Red cells appear normocytic and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with neutrophil hypersegmentation; formal lobe counts (more than 5% of neutrophils with five lobes or any with six) and B12/folate assessment are recommended.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia would typically show macro-ovalocytes and increased MCV along with hypersegmentation, which are not evident here.
Ring neutrophils have a continuous annular nucleus without separation into discrete lobes, unlike the segmented ring-like arrangement here.

ddx.dx: Reactive neutrophilia with toxic change only
ddx.vs: Toxic neutrophils show coarse granules, Döhle bodies, and vacuoles but normal lobe counts of two to four.
The benign inherited trait is diagnosed by persistent hypersegmentation with normal vitamins and a positive family history.

65589.recognize_zh: CSF 中出現成群、體積大且彼此黏合的非造血細胞，核大而圓、染色質粗顆粒、細胞表面佈滿泡狀突起（surface blebs），在乳癌病人要想到軟腦膜轉移癌。
features: Numerous large cells, many in pairs and small cohesive groups
High N:C ratio with enlarged round nuclei and coarsely granular chromatin; nucleoli indistinct at this focus
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm with prominent, uniform peripheral cytoplasmic blebs
Cells markedly larger than the rare red cells in the background
No normal lymphocytes or monocytes in this field
65589.describe_en: CSF cytospin shows numerous large atypical cells arranged singly, in pairs, and in small cohesive groups. The cells have high N:C ratios, enlarged round nuclei with coarsely granular chromatin, and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm with conspicuous peripheral cytoplasmic blebs. Normal lymphocytes and monocytes are not seen in this field. The cohesive growth in a patient with known breast carcinoma favors metastatic carcinoma; with AE1/AE3 positivity and CD45 negativity, findings are consistent with leptomeningeal metastatic carcinoma of mammary origin.

ddx.dx: Leukemic or lymphoma involvement of CSF
ddx.vs: Lymphoma and leukemic blasts are discohesive single cells and CD45 positive, whereas these cells form cohesive groups and are keratin positive, CD45 negative.
Megakaryoblasts can show surface blebs but lack cohesion and express CD41/CD61, not cytokeratin.

ddx.dx: Medulloblastoma or other primary CNS tumor
ddx.vs: Small round blue cell tumors have scant cytoplasm, nuclear molding, and rosettes, and lack epithelial keratin expression in this clinical setting.
Ependymal and choroid plexus cells are bland, uniform, with low N:C ratio and small numbers, unlike these large atypical cells.

65461.recognize_zh: 藍色箭頭指的是一顆脹大、顏色變淡的紅血球，裡面有多個紫紅色小點狀或小環狀的裂殖子，並夾雜棕色色素，是間日瘧（P. vivax）的裂殖體。圓圈中是一顆鐮刀狀紅血球；背景有明顯大小與形狀不一，包括淚滴狀與不規則紅血球。
features: Enlarged, pale infected red cell containing multiple small purple merozoite-like chromatin dots and small rings (schizont, blue arrow)
Fine brownish pigment granules within the infected cell
Infected cell larger than surrounding red cells, favoring P. vivax/ovale over P. falciparum
Crescent-shaped sickle cell with pointed ends (circled)
Marked anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop-like, pointed and target-like red cells
65461.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop-like and pointed red cells, occasional target-like forms and a sickle cell. One red cell is enlarged and pale and contains multiple chromatin dots and small ring-like merozoites with scattered brown malarial pigment, consistent with a schizont. Enlargement of the host red cell favors Plasmodium vivax. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax infection in a patient with sickle cell disease; thick and thin smear parasitemia quantification and rapid antigen or PCR confirmation of species are recommended.

ddx.vs: Falciparum schizonts are rarely seen in peripheral blood, infected cells are not enlarged, and multiple delicate rings and banana-shaped gametocytes predominate.
P. ovale also enlarges red cells but typically shows oval, fimbriated host cells and schizonts with fewer (about 8) merozoites.
P. malariae infects normal-sized or small red cells and forms rosette schizonts or band forms with coarse dark pigment.
Babesia shows small pleomorphic rings and tetrad (Maltese cross) forms without pigment or schizonts.

65397.recognize_zh: 多格骨髓抹片中漿細胞明顯增加，核偏位並有核周淡染區，細胞質從深藍到粉紫都有，可見雙核與細胞質邊緣呈粉紅火焰狀的形態，背景錢串狀紅血球，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Many plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and perinuclear hof
Heterogeneous cytoplasm ranging from deep blue to pale pink-lilac with frayed edges (flame-like forms)
Binucleated and irregular plasma cells; a cell with a cytoplasmic bleb
Some larger plasma cells with more dispersed chromatin
Background rouleaux with scattered neutrophils
65397.describe_en: Composite bone marrow aspirate fields show a marked increase in plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and perinuclear hof. There is cytologic heterogeneity, including binucleated forms, enlarged cells with more dispersed chromatin, and cells with pale pink-lilac or flame-like frayed cytoplasm. Rouleaux formation is evident in the background with occasional neutrophils. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature and polytypic, generally under 10%, without binucleation or marked size variation.
Contains a dominant component of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with MYD88 L265P and an IgM paraprotein.
Morphology may overlap, so separation depends on clonal plasma cells below 10% and absence of myeloma-defining events.

65205.recognize_zh: 臨床照片可見瀰漫性紅疹（DRESS）；淋巴結副皮質區明顯擴張，高倍可見大型單核細胞帶有核內與細胞質包涵體，HHV-6 染色呈顆粒狀陽性，ICOS 標記副皮質 T 細胞、CD20 陽性 B 細胞被推擠到外皮質，屬於模仿淋巴瘤的病毒性淋巴結炎。
features: Lymph node with marked paracortical expansion and compression of residual follicles toward the capsule at low power (B)
Polymorphous paracortex with many large mononuclear cells bearing eosinophilic nuclear and cytoplasmic inclusions among small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells (C)
HHV-6 immunostain decorates scattered large cells with membranous and dot-like Golgi/cytoplasmic positivity (D)
ICOS positivity in the expanded paracortical T-cell population including infected cells (E)
CD20-positive B cells restricted to a thin rim of the far cortex (F)
Clinical photo of a confluent erythematous morbilliform rash on the extremity (A)
65205.describe_en: The lymph node shows distorted architecture with marked paracortical expansion, while B cells highlighted by CD20 are largely confined to the far cortex. The expanded paracortex contains a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, immunoblasts and scattered large mononuclear cells with conspicuous nuclear and cytoplasmic inclusions. The large cells are immunoreactive for HHV-6 with membrane and Golgi-type positivity, and the paracortical T cells express ICOS. In the setting of a diffuse drug rash with eosinophilia, findings are consistent with HHV-6 lymphadenitis associated with DRESS syndrome; clonality studies (negative TCR gamma PCR) help exclude a T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: AITL also expresses TFH markers such as ICOS but shows clear-cell TFH clusters, arborizing HEVs, expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks and clonal TCR rearrangement, without HHV-6+ inclusion-bearing cells.
PTCL shows cytologically atypical T cells with aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR, rather than viral inclusions with a reactive, polyclonal background.
Paracortical expansion is due to pale Langerhans/interdigitating cells with melanin-laden macrophages, not large cells with viral inclusions.
Paracortical immunoblasts are EBER-positive and lack HHV-6 immunoreactivity and nuclear inclusions.

65205.stain: Clinical photo; H&E; IHC: HHV-6, ICOS, CD20

65077.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的骨髓腔被大型異常細胞取代，細胞核大、呈泡狀並有明顯核仁，背景夾雜梭形基質細胞；箭頭處細胞質內有小圓形包涵物，但在此倍率下難以明確判定為被吞噬的紅血球。
features: Bone trabecula (upper left) with intertrabecular space replaced by a diffuse infiltrate
Large atypical cells with vesicular, round to irregular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, most evident in the lower right
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; arrowed cell contains a small round intracytoplasmic body
Admixed spindle-shaped stromal/fibroblastic cells with a streaming, fibrotic background
Scattered small fat spaces; normal hematopoiesis not appreciable in this field
65077.describe_en: H&E-stained section including a bone trabecula shows the marrow space replaced by a diffuse infiltrate of large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate cytoplasm, admixed with spindle-shaped stromal cells in a fibrotic background. The arrowed cell contains a small round intracytoplasmic body that may represent an engulfed red cell, although erythrophagocytosis is difficult to confirm at this magnification. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is not evident in this field. In a patient with CLL, findings are suggestive of involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (Richter transformation), to be confirmed by immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Cohesive nests, keratin or S100/SOX10 positivity and absent CD45/CD20 separate non-hematopoietic tumors from large B-cell lymphoma.
HLH shows bland histiocytes containing red cells without sheets of atypical large nucleolated cells.
Scattered CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background differ from sheets of CD20+ large cells.
Clustered hyperlobated or hyperchromatic megakaryocytes with streaming fibrosis lack the uniform lymphoid large-cell sheets and are CD61-positive.

65013.recognize_zh: 血液抹片紅血球大小不一且形狀多變：圓圈處為較大的巨紅血球（macrocyte），箭頭指一顆布滿粗大藍黑色點狀的嗜鹼性斑點（basophilic stippling）紅血球，另散在碎裂紅血球與鋸齒狀細胞；配合 B12 低下與 MCV 升高，符合巨母細胞性貧血的周邊血變化。
features: Marked anisocytosis with scattered macrocytes (circled) larger than surrounding RBCs
Red cell with coarse basophilic stippling (arrow)
Poikilocytosis including fragmented cells/schistocytes, oval cells and crenated/spiculated forms
Occasional RBC with a small dark inclusion and a single polychromatophilic cell
Platelets present; no leukocytes (and therefore no hypersegmented neutrophils) in this field
65013.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisocytosis and poikilocytosis. Scattered macrocytes and oval forms are present, together with fragmented red cells and crenated or spiculated forms. One red cell shows coarse basophilic stippling, and occasional cells contain small dark inclusions. No leukocytes are present in this field, so neutrophil hypersegmentation cannot be assessed. In the context of elevated MCV and low vitamin B12, findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia with dyserythropoietic red cell changes.

ddx.vs: Stippling in lead toxicity and thalassemia occurs with microcytic hypochromic cells, whereas this smear shows macrocytes and oval macrocytes with an elevated MCV.
MDS can produce macrocytosis and poikilocytosis but has normal B12/folate, pseudo-Pelger neutrophils or dysgranulopoiesis, and does not respond to vitamin replacement.
TMA shows numerous schistocytes with marked thrombocytopenia and reticulocytosis, whereas megaloblastic anemia has low reticulocytes and fragments are accompanied by macro-ovalocytes.
These produce round thin macrocytes and target cells rather than macro-ovalocytes, and B12/folate are normal.

65141.recognize_zh: 紅血球背景中散在多個大型母細胞，核圓到有摺疊或凹陷、染色質細緻並可見核仁，細胞質中等、灰藍色且邊緣含許多小空泡；其中一顆細胞核周有細顆粒。這些帶空泡的母細胞與腹水中的細胞型態相同，支持 AML 的診斷。圖中是 Romanowsky 染色，並非敘述中的 MPO 染色。
features: Scattered large blasts in an RBC-rich smear, several times the size of an RBC
Round to indented or folded nuclei with fine to slightly coarse dispersed chromatin and visible nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm with numerous small peripheral clear vacuoles
Occasional cell with fine azurophilic granulation; one smudged cell at top of field
No MPO reaction product is shown; image is a Romanowsky-stained smear
65141.describe_en: Romanowsky-stained smear, likely bone marrow aspirate, shows numerous large blasts dispersed among red cells. The blasts have round to folded or indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, visible nucleoli, and moderate grey-blue cytoplasm with prominent small vacuoles, occasionally with fine granulation. Auer rods are not clearly seen at this magnification, and although the case description refers to MPO positivity, no cytochemical stain is shown in this image. The blast morphology matches the cells seen in the ascitic fluid and is consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation, as reported with inv(16).

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have scant non-vacuolated cytoplasm and are MPO-negative with TdT/CD19 or CD3 expression, whereas these blasts have more vacuolated cytoplasm and were MPO-positive.
APL cells have abundant coarse granules or bilobed nuclei with bundles of Auer rods and PML::RARA, not vacuolated monocytoid blasts.

t(8;21) blasts often have a perinuclear hof, salmon-coloured granules and single long Auer rods, while inv(16) typically shows monocytic features with abnormal eosinophils; cytogenetics or RUNX1::RUNX1T1 versus CBFB::MYH11 testing separates them.
Burkitt cells show deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles and a mature B-cell phenotype with MYC rearrangement.

64885.recognize_zh: 在紅血球重疊的厚區中，中間那顆嗜中性球的胞質內可見數個金黃色、具折光性的長方形結晶，旁邊細胞胞質呈泡沫狀空泡化，符合 EDTA 血液中形成的膽紅素結晶，並伴隨毒性變化。
features: Neutrophil containing several golden-yellow, refractile rectangular to rhomboid cytoplasmic crystals
Vacuolated, foamy neutrophil cytoplasm consistent with toxic change
Band or less segmented neutrophil at the top suggesting left shift
Thick area of smear with overlapping, crenated red cells limiting assessment
64885.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a thick area with overlapping red cells, shows neutrophils with vacuolated cytoplasm and a less segmented form at the top of the field. One neutrophil contains several golden-yellow, refractile rectangular to rhomboid intracytoplasmic crystals. The thick smear region limits evaluation of red cell morphology. In an EDTA sample from a patient with marked hyperbilirubinemia, findings are consistent with in vitro bilirubin crystal formation in neutrophils, with accompanying toxic changes.

ddx.vs: Cryoglobulins appear as pale blue amorphous or crystalline extracellular and intracellular material that disappears when the sample is warmed, rather than golden refractile crystals.
Hemosiderin is granular and irregular, brown to blue-black and Prussian blue positive, not geometric rectangular crystals.
Hemozoin is fine brown-black granules or clumps and is accompanied by intraerythrocytic parasites.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are bipyramidal, colorless to pale, and derived from eosinophils rather than yellow rectangular crystals in neutrophils.

64821.recognize_zh: CD30 免疫染色中許多中大型細胞呈強烈的膜狀加核旁高爾基區點狀（Golgi）棕色陽性，陽性細胞密集且大小不一，其間夾雜淡藍色陰性小細胞與組織球，符合間變性大細胞淋巴瘤的 CD30 表現。
features: Strong, uniform CD30 staining in numerous medium to large cells
Membranous staining with paranuclear Golgi-zone dot accentuation
Positive cells show variable size, including horseshoe-shaped nuclear outlines
Interspersed CD30-negative small cells and histiocytes with pale blue nuclei
Dense, diffuse distribution of positive cells in this field
64821.describe_en: CD30 immunohistochemistry shows strong membranous and Golgi-pattern staining in numerous atypical medium to large lymphoid cells, some with horseshoe-shaped nuclear outlines. Positive cells are admixed with CD30-negative small lymphocytes and histiocytes. The staining is uniform and intense across the neoplastic population. In conjunction with ALK positivity, findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-positive; the dense positive population in this field is more conspicuous than is typical for the lymphohistiocytic pattern, where tumor cells are often obscured by histiocytes on H&E.

ddx.vs: Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+ and CD15+ but PAX5 weakly positive and ALK negative, and are scattered in an inflammatory background rather than forming sheets.

ddx.dx: ALK-negative ALCL or CD30-positive PTCL, NOS
ddx.vs: ALK-negative ALCL shows similar strong uniform CD30 but no ALK staining, while PTCL, NOS usually shows heterogeneous CD30 expression.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous ALCL or lymphomatoid papulosis
ddx.vs: These are skin-limited, ALK negative, and require clinical correlation.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive or activated large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These may express CD30 but are CD20 and PAX5 positive with B-cell lineage.

64757.recognize_zh: A 圖淋巴結中瀰漫的大型淋巴細胞，核不規則、染色質淡、核仁明顯；B 圖 BCL2 強陽性、C 圖 EBER 核陽性；D–F 圖 FISH 顯示 IGH/BCL2 融合訊號同時出現在 EBV 陽性（綠色點狀）的腫瘤細胞內。
features: Panel A (H&E): diffuse sheets of large lymphoid cells with irregular vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, with scattered apoptotic bodies
Panel B: strong cytoplasmic/membranous BCL2 staining in large cells
Panel C: EBER ISH with nuclear positivity in many large cells
Panel D: FISH with multiple green EBV signals within nuclei plus red (5'BCL2) and blue (3'IGH) probes
Panels E-F: single nuclei showing a colocalized red-blue fusion signal (arrowhead) in an EBV-positive cell, and a BCL2 break-apart pattern in an EBV-negative cell
64757.describe_en: Composite figure of a lymph node biopsy. The H&E section (A) shows diffuse effacement by large lymphoid cells with irregular vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and scattered apoptotic debris. The large cells are strongly BCL2 positive (B) and a large proportion show nuclear EBER positivity by in situ hybridization (C). FISH on paraffin sections (D-F) demonstrates punctate EBV genome signals within nuclei together with IGH::BCL2 fusion signals (arrowhead), and confirms BCL2 rearrangement in both EBV-positive and EBV-negative tumor cells. Findings are consistent with EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, germinal center type, harboring t(14;18)(q32;q21), with EBV infection likely acquired after the BCL2 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Typical EBV+ DLBCL is usually non-germinal-center type and lacks t(14;18), whereas this case is CD10+ with IGH::BCL2 fusion by FISH.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma requires an additional MYC rearrangement, which must be excluded by MYC FISH.
Transformation is supported by a prior or coexisting follicular component, which is not seen in this diffuse field.
Bystander EBV infection involves only scattered small cells, whereas here EBER and FISH EBV signals are present in the large neoplastic cells carrying the fusion.

64757.stain: H&E; IHC: BCL2; ISH: EBER; FISH

64309.recognize_zh: 這是未設門的流式散點圖（CD138 對 CD38）：傳統漿細胞框（CD38+/CD138+）內幾乎沒有細胞，但右下方有一群 CD138+ 而 CD38 陰性/弱的細胞（紅色），提示 daratumumab 治療後 CD38 抗原被遮蔽，漿細胞仍存在。
features: Ungated bivariate dot plot of CD138 (x-axis) versus CD38 (y-axis) on log scales
Conventional CD38-bright/CD138+ plasma cell gate (upper right box) contains essentially no events
Discrete population (red) with CD138 expression above 10^1 but CD38 at negative-to-dim levels
Bulk of marrow events (gray) CD138-negative with low CD38
64309.describe_en: This is an ungated flow cytometry dot plot of bone marrow displaying CD138 versus CD38. The standard plasma cell gate for CD38-bright/CD138-positive events contains essentially no cells, which on its own would suggest absence of plasma cells. However, a distinct population highlighted in red expresses CD138 while being negative to dim for CD38. In a patient previously treated with daratumumab, this pattern indicates that CD38 is masked or downregulated on residual plasma cells, which should be gated with CD138 and alternative markers (e.g., CD229, CD319, multiepitope CD38) and assessed for light-chain restriction; findings are consistent with CD38-negative persistent myeloma.

ddx.dx: True complete response / no residual plasma cells
ddx.vs: Absence of events in the CD38+/CD138+ gate is misleading after anti-CD38 therapy, and a CD138+ CD38- population with cytoplasmic kappa restriction indicates persistent disease.
Debris lacks forward/side scatter characteristics of plasma cells and cytoplasmic light-chain restriction, which were demonstrated in the gated population.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or other CD138+ neoplasm
ddx.vs: Separation relies on clinical history, morphology and immunophenotype (e.g., MYC, EBER, CD45), not on this single plot.

64501.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維銀染下，黑色細纖維在造血區內交織成網並包繞個別細胞（pericellular），形成細密格子狀，而非局限於血管周圍，代表網狀纖維增加（約 MF-1 至 2 級），常見於毛細胞白血病骨髓。
features: Increased black argyrophilic reticulin fibers forming a loose to dense meshwork within cellular marrow areas
Fibers encircle individual cells in a pericellular (chicken-wire) pattern
Numerous intersections of fibers without thick collagen bundles evident
Interspersed fat spaces with fibers outlining adipocyte borders
Cell nuclei appear dark; greenish-brown counterstain; photographic resolution and focus are limited
64501.describe_en: Reticulin (silver) stain of the bone marrow core biopsy shows an increased network of fine black reticulin fibers with numerous intersections, wrapping around individual cells in a pericellular pattern within the cellular areas and outlining fat spaces. Coarse collagen bundles are not evident in this image, although resolution is limited. The fiber density corresponds approximately to grade MF-1 to MF-2. In the context of hairy cell leukemia, these findings reflect the characteristic pericellular reticulin fibrosis that often results in a dry tap aspirate.

ddx.vs: PMF fibrosis is accompanied by clustered atypical cloud-like megakaryocytes and often collagen and osteosclerosis, rather than fine pericellular fibers around a monotonous lymphoid infiltrate.
Normal reticulin is sparse, scattered linear fibers mainly perivascular without intersections, not a dense pericellular meshwork.
Mastocytosis shows fibrosis localized within paratrabecular or perivascular spindle mast-cell aggregates confirmed by tryptase/CD117, not diffuse pericellular fibers.
Desmoplastic carcinoma shows coarse collagenous fibrosis around cohesive epithelial nests that are keratin positive.

64565.recognize_zh: 視野中有多個嗜酸性球：有的顆粒稀疏、細胞質淡藍空白（低顆粒化），有的核分成四葉以上（分葉過多），還夾雜圓形或凹陷核、帶混合顆粒的嗜酸性前驅細胞，提示異常嗜酸性球增多。
features: Multiple eosinophils in one field, several with sparse granules and pale blue cytoplasmic clearing (hypogranular)
Hypersegmented eosinophil with four or more small nuclear lobes and few granules (bottom center)
Eosinophil precursors (myelocytes/metamyelocytes) with round to kidney-shaped nuclei and mixed orange and dark purple granules (left)
Large eosinophil with irregular multilobated nucleus and coarse granules (lower left)
Unevenly distributed granules leaving cytoplasmic areas agranular
Background red cells unremarkable; scattered platelets
64565.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows eosinophilia with dysplastic features. Several eosinophils are hypogranular with patchy cytoplasmic clearing, and one shows nuclear hypersegmentation with four or more lobes. Circulating eosinophil precursors with round to indented nuclei and mixed orange and dark granules are also present. Findings are suggestive of a clonal eosinophilic process such as a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRA rearrangement, to be confirmed by FISH or molecular testing.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils are typically bilobed and fully granulated without circulating precursors, although hypogranularity can occasionally be reactive.
Hypersegmented neutrophils have fine lilac granules and no orange eosinophilic granules, and are accompanied by macro-ovalocytes.
CML shows a left-shifted neutrophilic series with basophilia rather than selective eosinophil-lineage expansion, and BCR::ABL1 is positive.

64437.recognize_zh: 胸水抹片中有大量漿母細胞：核偏心、染色質較開放、細胞質深嗜鹼性並有核周淡染區，但沒有明顯多形或間變性。這些細胞 CD138、HHV-8 LANA（點狀核染色）與 IgM 陽性，並限制表現 λ 輕鏈。淋巴結呈多中心 Castleman 病型態，套區內散布 LANA 陽性細胞。
features: Panel A (effusion cytospin): numerous plasmablasts with eccentric round nuclei, open chromatin, occasional nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Plasmablasts are medium-sized and relatively uniform without marked anaplasia or multinucleation
Cell block IHC: CD138 membranous (B), speckled nuclear HHV-8 LANA (C), cytoplasmic IgM (D)
Panel E: LANA (brown) / lambda (red) double stain showing lambda-restricted LANA+ plasmablasts
Panel F: lymph node with expanded mantle zone and a penetrating hyalinized vessel (green arrow) typical of multicentric Castleman disease
Panel G: scattered LANA+ plasmablasts in mantle zones with speckled nuclear pattern (inset)
64437.describe_en: Pleural fluid cytology shows abundant plasmablasts with eccentric nuclei, open chromatin, small nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing, lacking marked anaplasia. On cell block, the cells are CD138-positive, show speckled nuclear HHV-8 LANA staining and express cytoplasmic IgM with lambda light chain restriction, and they are negative for CD20, CD30 and EBV. The concurrent lymph node shows regressed germinal centers with expanded mantle zones, a penetrating vessel and scattered LANA-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zones. Findings are consistent with HHV-8-associated multicentric Castleman disease presenting with a plasmablast-rich pleural effusion, mimicking primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: PEL cells are large and anaplastic/immunoblastic, usually EBV-coinfected, CD45+ but lack surface/cytoplasmic immunoglobulin, whereas these plasmablasts are bland, EBV-negative and IgM-lambda-positive.
Plasmablastic lymphoma forms tissue masses of EBER-positive plasmablasts that are HHV-8 LANA-negative.

ddx.dx: HHV-8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: HHV-8+ DLBCL forms confluent sheets of LANA+ IgM-lambda plasmablasts that efface nodal architecture, rather than scattered mantle-zone plasmablasts in MCD.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis or plasma cell myeloma in effusion
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are polytypic and LANA-negative, and myeloma cells are mature-appearing, CD56+/cyclin D1+ often with an M protein, which was absent here.

64437.stain: Wright-Giemsa; IHC: CD138, HHV-8 LANA, IgM, lambda; H&E

64245.recognize_zh: 乳酚棉藍（lactophenol cotton blue）染色下可見有隔膜、銳角分枝的菌絲，分生孢子梗末端膨大成頂囊，瓶梗只長在頂囊上半部並向上排列（uniseriate），頂端串著小圓形分生孢子，符合 Aspergillus fumigatus。
features: Hyaline, narrow, septate hyphae with parallel walls and acute-angle branching
Unbranched conidiophores ending in a swollen, flask- to club-shaped vesicle
Phialides covering only the upper half to two-thirds of the vesicle, oriented upward parallel to the conidiophore axis (uniseriate, columnar head)
Chains of small round conidia extending from the phialides
Lactophenol cotton blue wet mount with granular background debris
64245.describe_en: Lactophenol cotton blue preparation from a fungal culture of bronchoalveolar lavage material shows hyaline, septate hyphae of uniform narrow width with acute-angle branching. Several conidiophores terminate in dome- to flask-shaped vesicles bearing a single row of phialides restricted to the upper portion of the vesicle, with columnar chains of small round conidia directed upward. Findings are consistent with Aspergillus fumigatus complex; species-level confirmation may require growth characteristics or MALDI-TOF/sequencing.

ddx.vs: A. flavus has a round vesicle covered over its entire surface by radiating uniseriate and biseriate phialides with rough-walled conidiophores, unlike the upper-half columnar head of A. fumigatus.
A. niger shows a large globose vesicle entirely covered by biseriate phialides with dark brown-black conidia.
Penicillium lacks a swollen vesicle and instead forms brush-like branched metulae and phialides (penicillus).
Mucorales have broad, ribbon-like, pauciseptate hyphae with right-angle branching and sporangia containing sporangiospores rather than conidial chains on phialides.

64181.recognize_zh: 低倍血片可見多個兩端尖細的鐮刀狀與船形紅血球，混有標靶細胞，而且許多紅血球內有圓形深紫色的 Howell-Jolly 小體；鐮刀細胞加上 Howell-Jolly 小體，指向 HbSS 合併功能性無脾。
features: Numerous irreversibly sickled cells (elongated with pointed ends) and boat-shaped cells
Scattered target cells
Many red cells contain a single small, round, dense basophilic Howell-Jolly body
Occasional larger, bluish polychromatic red cell
Variable red cell size and shape; platelets present and not clumped
Low-power (x20) view limits assessment of fine inclusions such as Pappenheimer bodies
64181.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows marked poikilocytosis with numerous sickle cells and boat-shaped cells, together with target cells. Many red cells contain a single round, dense Howell-Jolly body, and occasional polychromatic macrocytes are present. The density of Howell-Jolly bodies indicates loss of splenic filtering function. Findings are consistent with sickle cell anemia (HbSS) with functional hyposplenism; hemoglobin separation (HPLC or electrophoresis) is required to define the genotype.

ddx.vs: HbSC shows fewer classic sickle cells and characteristic straight-edged, crystal-containing 'folded' or 'Washington monument' cells with more target cells, confirmed by HbS and HbC peaks on HPLC.
Tends to show more microcytosis and hypochromia with target cells; separation requires HbA2 quantitation, MCV, and family or DNA studies.
Surgical asplenia also produces abundant Howell-Jolly bodies and target cells but lacks sickle cells unless a sickling hemoglobin is present.
Elliptocytes have rounded, blunt ends and uniform oval shape, whereas sickle cells here are crescentic with tapered ends.

64053.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中四顆中至大型的非典型淋巴樣細胞，核質比極高、染色質細緻、隱約可見核仁，其中幾顆核有凹陷或裂溝（notch/cleft），外觀像母細胞但細胞質極少、無顆粒，需以流式細胞儀區分母細胞與高惡性度淋巴瘤白血化。
features: Four intermediate-to-large atypical mononuclear cells, about 1.5–2 times a red cell diameter
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale agranular cytoplasm
Round to indented nuclei, with nuclear notches/clefts in some cells
Finely dispersed to slightly condensed chromatin with faint small nucleoli
Background red cells largely normocytic/normochromic with occasional elongated forms; platelets present
64053.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with occasional elongated forms and adequate platelets. There are several intermediate-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, scant agranular cytoplasm, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and nuclear notching or clefting in some cells. No Auer rods, cytoplasmic granules or vacuoles are seen. Findings are consistent with circulating blastoid atypical lymphoid cells; in the clinical context of t(14;18)-positive lymphoma this is suggestive of leukemic spill of a high-grade/transformed B-cell lymphoma, with flow cytometry needed to exclude acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: Blasts are TdT/CD34 positive and, if myeloid, may carry granules or Auer rods, so immunophenotyping is needed because morphology alone cannot exclude blastic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of follicular lymphoma (buttock cells)
ddx.vs: Low-grade FL cells are small with condensed chromatin and deep clefts, rather than intermediate-to-large cells with dispersed chromatin and nucleoli.
Blastoid MCL has similar cytology but is CD5+/cyclin D1+/SOX11+.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant basophilic cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and a heterogeneous spectrum, not uniform high N:C cells.

63989.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片中滿布大小一致、胞質少的芽細胞，箭頭指出數個散在的大型巨噬細胞，胞質淡藍、呈纖維或網狀紋理，為急性骨髓性白血病中的類 Gaucher 細胞。
features: Hypercellular aspirate dominated by a monotonous population of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Scattered large histiocytes with abundant pale blue, fibrillar to reticulated cytoplasm (arrows and arrowheads)
Some histiocytes contain small cytoplasmic vacuoles or engulfed debris
Relatively few maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors in the background
Marrow particle with fat spaces at the lower right; nuclear detail limited at 20x
63989.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power is cellular and composed predominantly of a monotonous population of medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. Scattered among the blasts are several large histiocytes with abundant pale blue, fibrillar cytoplasm (arrows and arrowheads), resembling Gaucher cells. Residual maturing hematopoietic elements are reduced, and a fat-containing particle is present at the lower right. Detailed chromatin, nucleoli, and Auer rods cannot be assessed at this magnification. In a patient with acute myeloid leukemia, findings are consistent with pseudo-Gaucher cells in a blast-rich marrow.

ddx.vs: Gaucher disease shows Gaucher cells in a marrow with normal maturation and no blast excess, and has deficient glucocerebrosidase activity.

ddx.dx: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia with reactive histiocytes
ddx.vs: ALL blasts lack MPO and Auer rods and are CD19/CD3 lineage by flow, which low-power morphology cannot resolve.
Tumor cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear molding rather than single histiocytes with fibrillar cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei.
Megakaryocytes have large multilobated nuclei and granular pink cytoplasm, unlike the pale fibrillar cytoplasm and small nuclei of Gaucher-like cells.

63861.recognize_zh: 兩格血片中有許多小而深染、失去中央淡染區的球形紅血球（spherocytes），夾雜較大偏藍的多染性紅血球；箭頭所指細胞一側有凹口、形如鉗子或蘑菇（pincer cell），是 band 3 缺乏型遺傳性球形紅血球症的線索。
features: Numerous small, dense, round red cells lacking central pallor (spherocytes/microspherocytes)
Occasional pincer (mushroom-shaped) red cells with a single notch or cleft on one side (arrows)
Larger, slightly bluish-gray polychromatophilic red cells indicating reticulocytosis
Marked anisocytosis with admixed normal discocytes showing central pallor
Scattered platelets; no schistocytes, sickle cells or target cells prominent
63861.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (two fields, Leishman stain) shows marked anisocytosis with a population of small, dense spherocytes lacking central pallor admixed with larger polychromatophilic red cells. Scattered red cells show a single notch-like indentation producing a pincer or mushroom shape (arrows). Schistocytes, sickle cells and prominent target cells are not seen. Findings are consistent with a hemolytic process with spherocytes and pincer cells; in the setting of lifelong jaundice, splenomegaly and a positive family history, they are suggestive of hereditary spherocytosis, particularly the band 3-deficient type.

ddx.vs: Spherocytes look identical, so a positive IgG direct antiglobulin test and absence of pincer cells or family history favor AIHA.
MAHA shows true schistocytes (helmet cells, triangles, fragments) with thrombocytopenia rather than intact cells with a single notch.

ddx.dx: Oxidative hemolysis (G6PD deficiency) with bite cells
ddx.vs: Bite cells have a bitten-out rim with blister cells and Heinz bodies on supravital stain, and G6PD activity is low, which was normal here.

ddx.dx: Southeast Asian ovalocytosis or hereditary elliptocytosis
ddx.vs: These show stomatocytic ovalocytes or elliptocytes rather than round spherocytes, and they are confirmed by EMA binding and membrane gene testing.

63925.recognize_zh: 上排血片可見中至大型淋巴樣細胞，核不規則或有凹裂、染色質細緻、偶見小核仁、細胞質少而偏藍，外觀像芽細胞；下排流式為 CD19+ CD5+ CD20 強陽性 CD10+、CD23− CD200−、CD79b+ 的單株 B 細胞，提示 CD10 陽性的芽細胞樣被套細胞淋巴瘤，需 cyclin D1/t(11;14) 確認。
features: Medium to large lymphoid cells, about 1.5-2 times RBC diameter, with high N:C ratio
Irregular, notched or cleaved nuclei with finely dispersed blastoid chromatin and occasional small nucleoli
Scant to moderate basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Flow cytometry: abnormal B cells (92.4% of lymphocytes) CD19+, CD5+, CD20 bright, CD10+, CD79b+, CD38+
Abnormal B cells are CD23 negative and CD200 negative; residual normal B cells are rare (0.056%)
63925.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, notched nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and scant basophilic cytoplasm, imparting a blastoid appearance. The accompanying flow cytometry plots demonstrate a dominant abnormal B-cell population (92.4% of lymphocytes) that expresses CD19, CD5, bright CD20, CD10, CD79b and CD38 and lacks CD23 and CD200. The CD5+ CD23- CD200- phenotype with blastoid morphology is suggestive of blastoid mantle cell lymphoma with aberrant CD10 expression, which requires confirmation by cyclin D1 immunostaining or CCND1 rearrangement (t(11;14)) FISH.

ddx.vs: CLL is CD5+ CD23+ CD200 bright with dim CD20/CD79b, whereas this population is CD23- CD200- with bright CD20.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma or leukemic Burkitt lymphoma (CD10+)
ddx.vs: These are usually CD5 negative, and Burkitt shows MYC rearrangement with vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm, whereas cyclin D1/CCND1 positivity identifies MCL.
B-ALL is TdT+ and CD34+ with dim or absent CD20 and surface light chains, unlike this bright CD20, mature-appearing CD79b+ population.
CD5+ DLBCL is cyclin D1 and SOX11 negative without t(11;14), which separates it from blastoid MCL.

63797.recognize_zh: 低倍視野內白血球明顯增加，以單核球為主，其中有細胞核較圓、染色質較細、胞質灰藍的幼稚單核球／原單核球；旁邊的嗜中性球顆粒稀少、分葉不良，呈現發育不良（dysplasia），這種「單核球增多＋嗜中性球異形」組合提示 CMML。
features: Increased monocytes, several with folded or kidney-shaped nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm
Occasional larger immature forms (promonocytes/monoblasts) with round-oval nuclei, finer chromatin and moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm
Neutrophils with hypogranular pale cytoplasm and abnormal/hyposegmented nuclear lobation (dysgranulopoiesis)
No Auer rods or prominent granules in the immature cells
Background red cells without striking abnormality; few platelets
63797.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows leukocytosis with an absolute monocytosis. The monocytes range from mature forms with folded nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm to immature monocytes, and a few larger cells with round to oval nuclei, finer chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm consistent with monoblasts/promonocytes. Several neutrophils are hypogranular with abnormal nuclear segmentation, indicating dysgranulopoiesis. Blasts plus promonocytes appear to be a minority of the nucleated cells in this field, although a formal differential count is required. Findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytes are mature without a spectrum of immature forms, and neutrophils lack hypogranularity or pseudo-Pelger changes; persistence >3 months and clonal studies help.
AML requires blasts plus promonocytes ≥20% of blood or marrow cells, whereas CMML has <20% blast equivalents.
CML shows a left-shifted granulocytic series with basophilia and myelocyte bulge rather than monocytosis with dysplasia, and is BCR::ABL1 positive.
Atypical CML is dominated by dysplastic neutrophils and circulating immature granulocytes with monocytes <10% of WBC.

63733.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有數個核偏心、胞質藍灰、核旁淡染區（hof）的成熟漿細胞，背景（箭頭）則布滿淡紫藍色、細顆粒至絲狀的無細胞沉澱物，這是低溫下析出的冷凝球蛋白（cryoglobulin），不是細胞碎片或血小板。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clock-face chromatin, basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hof
Admixed small round cells with dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm (lymphocytes/late erythroid precursors)
Background coated by extracellular pale violet granular to fibrillary amorphous precipitate (arrows)
Red cells appear pale and ghost-like with refractile outlines, partly obscured by the precipitate
Few elongated smeared nuclear strands (crush artifact)
63733.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing, admixed with small lymphoid cells or late erythroid precursors. The background contains abundant extracellular, pale violet, finely granular to fibrillary precipitate (arrows) that lies between cells and over red cells, consistent with precipitated cryoglobulin. Plasma cell percentage cannot be estimated from this single field. In a patient with multiple myeloma, the findings are consistent with a monoclonal (type I) cryoglobulin precipitating in the smear.

ddx.vs: Platelets are discrete granular bodies with a pale hyalomere, whereas cryoglobulin forms an amorphous confluent granular-fibrillar coating.
Stain precipitate is dark, crystalline and lies in a different focal plane, while cryoglobulin is pale, homogeneous and dissolves when the sample is warmed to 37°C.
Amyloid appears as waxy pale-blue acellular clumps that are Congo red positive with apple-green birefringence, not a diffuse granular precipitate.
Immunoglobulin crystals are intracellular needle-like or rhomboid inclusions in plasma cells or histiocytes rather than extracellular precipitate.

63605.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數個圓形、胞質幾乎透明無色、內含小空泡且細胞核被推到邊緣的大細胞，大小遠超周圍造血細胞，是骨髓脂肪細胞（adipocytes）。
features: Large round cells, several times the diameter of surrounding hematopoietic cells
Abundant clear to very pale lavender cytoplasm filled with lipid (appearing empty or finely vacuolated)
Single small, oval, eccentric nucleus compressed to the periphery
Adipocytes embedded within a cellular particle of small dark hematopoietic cells
Background of thick smear areas with cracked, grey-staining proteinaceous/lipid material
63605.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows a cellular particle containing several large round adipocytes with abundant clear, lipid-filled cytoplasm and small, eccentric, compressed nuclei. The surrounding cells are small hematopoietic cells, which cannot be characterized in detail at this magnification. No crystals, organisms, or foamy histiocytic cytoplasm are seen in the fat cells. Findings are consistent with normal marrow adipocytes.

ddx.vs: Foamy macrophages have bubbly, finely vacuolated grey-blue cytoplasm with a central or bean-shaped nucleus rather than a single large clear lipid droplet with a flattened peripheral nucleus.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' blue-grey cytoplasm, not clear empty cytoplasm.
Gelatinous transformation shows small atrophic fat cells in pink-purple amorphous extracellular material with hypocellular marrow, rather than normal-sized adipocytes within cellular particles.

63541.recognize_zh: 中央有一顆胞質豐富、淡藍帶細顆粒卻只有單一圓形小核的巨核細胞（hypolobated／mononuclear megakaryocyte），周圍大量核質比高、染色質細緻的未成熟細胞，顯示骨髓異生合併芽細胞增加；標題所述核葉分離的小巨核細胞在此視野不明顯。
features: Central megakaryocyte with abundant pale granular cytoplasm and a single small round non-lobated nucleus (hypolobated/mononuclear form)
Numerous immature mononuclear cells with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and some visible nucleoli, suggestive of increased blasts
Scattered cells with round nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, including a deeply basophilic cell with perinuclear clearing
Densely cellular, crowded particle with clear lipid vacuoles and occasional red cells
Clearly separated multiple nuclear lobes in small megakaryocytes are not definitely identified in this field
63541.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular particle with a crowded population of immature mononuclear cells having high N:C ratios, fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli, suggesting increased blasts, which should be quantified on a differential count. A megakaryocyte in the center shows abundant pale granular cytoplasm with a single small, round, non-lobated nucleus, a dysplastic hypolobated (mononuclear) form. Micromegakaryocytes with widely separated nuclear lobes described for this case are not clearly identifiable in this particular field. In a patient with prior cytotoxic therapy, the dysmegakaryopoiesis and immature cell population are consistent with a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.vs: del(5q) MDS is characterized by small hypolobated megakaryocytes without increased blasts and has isolated 5q deletion on karyotype, whereas therapy-related disease often shows complex or -7/del(7q) karyotype.
Megakaryoblasts often show cytoplasmic blebs and are CD41/CD61 positive by flow, with at least 20% blasts of megakaryocytic lineage.
Osteoclasts contain multiple separate, uniform oval nuclei with nucleoli in a granular cytoplasm, rather than a single non-lobated nucleus.
Regenerating marrow may show small megakaryocytes, but persistent dysplasia with increased blasts and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities support a neoplasm.

63477.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中央一顆中型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，深藍色無顆粒的細胞質邊緣長出多個芽狀泡突（cytoplasmic blebs/budding），這種「冒泡」外觀是巨核母細胞（megakaryoblast）的典型線索；配合 CML 病史符合巨核母細胞急變。
features: Medium-sized blast with round nucleus and fine, homogeneous chromatin
Narrow rim of deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with multiple peripheral blebs/buds
Adjacent monocytoid cell with vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm (left) and small high N:C cells
Scattered pale platelets and a dark precipitate/platelet clump
Background red cells with mild crenation and rouleaux-like overlap
63477.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized blast with a round nucleus, fine homogeneous chromatin, and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm bearing multiple peripheral blebs. A monocytoid cell with vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm and small cells with high N:C ratios are also present. No granules or Auer rods are seen in the blast. Cytoplasmic blebbing is suggestive but not specific for megakaryocytic lineage; with CD41/CD61 expression by flow cytometry in a patient with CML, findings are consistent with megakaryoblastic blast crisis.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may show granules or Auer rods with MPO positivity and lack the CD41/CD61 expression of megakaryoblasts.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm without blebs and express TdT and B- or T-lineage antigens.

ddx.dx: Blebbing artifact in other blasts or lymphoma cells
ddx.vs: Cytoplasmic blebs can appear as a smear artifact in any blast or large lymphoid cell, so lineage requires immunophenotyping.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia de novo or with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so distinction rests on the BCR::ABL1 fusion and prior CML history versus GATA1 mutation or RBM15::MRTFA.

63349.recognize_zh: 四格骨髓抹片中都是大型多葉核巨核細胞（megakaryocyte），其細胞質內可見完整的小細胞（如左上格的嗜中性球）被包住，這種「細胞穿入但未被消化」的現象就是穿入現象（emperipolesis）。
features: Large megakaryocytes with abundant granular lavender cytoplasm and hyperlobated, folded nuclei
Intact hematopoietic cells, including a neutrophil with a ring-like segmented nucleus, lying within megakaryocyte cytoplasm
Engulfed cells retain normal nuclear morphology without degradation, unlike phagocytosis
Multiple megakaryocytes in the composite show the finding
Cellular aspirate background with maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors and red cells
63349.describe_en: Composite images of a bone marrow aspirate show several large mature megakaryocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm and hyperlobated nuclei. Intact hematopoietic cells, including neutrophils, are present within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm without evidence of degradation. The background marrow is cellular with maturing myeloid and erythroid elements. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic emperipolesis, which in this setting is likely reactive to an acute inflammatory state.

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytic histiocytes have a single oval nucleus with vacuolated cytoplasm containing degraded red cells and nuclear debris, whereas emperipolesis involves intact cells within megakaryocytes.
MPN-related emperipolesis occurs with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and fibrosis, while the megakaryocytes here are morphologically mature and dispersed.

ddx.dx: Overlapping cells in a thick smear
ddx.vs: Overlying cells lie in a different focal plane and outside the cytoplasmic outline, while emperipolesed cells sit within a cytoplasmic space often with a clear halo.

63285.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中白血球稀少，只見一顆胞質嗜鹼性、核染色質較細緻的不典型單核細胞（可能為芽細胞）與一顆小淋巴球，紅血球輕度大小不均；本圖本身缺乏足以診斷 AML-MRC 的形態特徵，需搭配骨髓與遺傳學。
features: Marked paucity of leukocytes in the field, suggesting leukopenia
One atypical mononuclear cell with moderately fine chromatin and a rim of basophilic cytoplasm, possibly a blast
One small mature lymphocyte with condensed chromatin
Red cells with mild anisocytosis and occasional elliptocytes/poikilocytes
No neutrophils to assess for dysgranulopoiesis; platelets sparse in this field
63285.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-to-medium power shows a paucicellular field with only two leukocytes, suggesting leukopenia. One is an atypical mononuclear cell with moderately fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm that may represent a circulating blast, and the other is a small mature lymphocyte. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional elliptocytes, and platelets appear decreased in this field. No neutrophils are present to evaluate for dysplasia. The findings are nonspecific and, while compatible with the clinical diagnosis of acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes, require correlation with bone marrow morphology, blast enumeration and cytogenetic/molecular studies.

ddx.vs: MDS may show identical cytopenias and rare circulating blasts; separation requires bone marrow blast count below 20% (or below the WHO 2022/ICC thresholds) rather than peripheral blood morphology.
Aplastic anemia shows pancytopenia without circulating blasts and a hypocellular marrow lacking dysplasia or blast excess.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and more condensed chromatin, without a population of immature blasts.

63029.recognize_zh: CD138 免疫染色中，棕色膜狀陽性的漿細胞圍繞在一個由小型陰性淋巴細胞組成的淋巴聚集（lymphoid aggregate）周邊呈環狀分布（rimming）；這種漿細胞包圍淋巴濾泡的型態是 POEMS 症候群骨髓的特徵線索。
features: CD138-positive plasma cells with crisp membranous brown staining
Plasma cells arranged around the periphery of a lymphoid aggregate (rimming pattern)
Lymphoid aggregate composed of small CD138-negative lymphocytes
Additional scattered interstitial CD138-positive plasma cells
No sheets or large confluent clusters of plasma cells
63029.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine immunostained for CD138 shows a lymphoid aggregate of small CD138-negative lymphocytes rimmed by CD138-positive plasma cells, with additional scattered interstitial plasma cells. The plasma cells show strong membranous staining and do not form sheets. Some nonspecific staining is present at the aggregate edge. Plasma cells rimming lymphoid aggregates are a characteristic marrow pattern in POEMS syndrome and should prompt light chain stains to demonstrate lambda restriction.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphoid aggregate with polytypic plasma cells
ddx.vs: Reactive aggregates may have occasional adjacent plasma cells, but these are polytypic on kappa/lambda staining rather than lambda-restricted.
Myeloma shows interstitial clusters or sheets of plasma cells unrelated to lymphoid aggregates, often with cytologic atypia and a higher burden.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: In MZL the aggregate itself contains clonal B cells (CD20+) and the plasma cells share the same light chain as the lymphoid component.

62965.recognize_zh: 脾臟紅髓脾索被大量淡粉紅、泡沫狀的組織球取代，旁邊白髓淋巴球聚集但無結節狀擴張；免疫染色只在白髓中見少量散在核陽性細胞，骨髓切片亦見散在淡染組織球，提示 Niemann-Pick 型儲積組織球合併輕微的非結節性淋巴瘤浸潤。
features: Spleen H&E (A): red pulp expanded by sheets of pale, foamy/vacuolated histiocytes
Periarteriolar white pulp lymphoid aggregate of small lymphocytes, not forming expansile nodules
IHC (B): scattered nuclear-positive small cells concentrated in the white pulp/marginal area with a negative background
BM biopsy (C): variably cellular marrow with fat and interstitial pale-staining histiocytes; no obvious lymphoid aggregate at this power
Resolution limits assessment of cytoplasmic lipid detail and the identity of the IHC marker
62965.describe_en: Composite figure. Splenic section shows red pulp diffusely expanded by pale foamy histiocytes, with a periarteriolar white pulp lymphoid aggregate that is not nodular or markedly expanded. An immunostain with nuclear staining highlights scattered small positive cells within the white pulp. The bone marrow biopsy shows fat and interstitial pale histiocytes without an obvious lymphoid aggregate. Findings are consistent with storage histiocytosis compatible with Niemann-Pick disease, with a subtle non-nodular lymphoma infiltrate (reported as leukemic non-nodal mantle cell lymphoma) requiring cyclin D1/SOX11 and flow cytometry for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have striated wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm (PAS+), whereas Niemann-Pick cells have finely vacuolated foamy cytoplasm with lipid, and enzyme assays separate them.

ddx.dx: Ceroid/sea-blue histiocytosis secondary to high cell turnover
ddx.vs: Secondary sea-blue histiocytes are scattered and granular with ceroid pigment, not diffuse foamy sheets; enzyme and genetic testing rule out primary storage disease.
SMZL shows nodular white pulp expansion with marginal zone differentiation and is cyclin D1/SOX11-negative.
Conventional MCL is usually SOX11+ with nodal disease and nodular or diffuse effacement, whereas leukemic non-nodal MCL is SOX11-negative with splenic and PB involvement.

62901.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中有一個大型單核吞噬細胞，細胞質豐富灰藍並含一個小而緻密的圓形核（被吞噬淋巴球的核）與數個血小板；背景紅血球聚成不規則團塊（RBC agglutination），這是冷凝集等自體免疫溶血時的線索。
features: Large mononuclear phagocyte with abundant grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Two overlapping round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Phagocytosed small dense round nucleus (consistent with an engulfed lymphocyte nucleus) and a few platelet fragments in the cytoplasm
Background red cells forming irregular clumps (agglutinates) rather than rouleaux
Adjacent small mature lymphocyte and scattered platelets
62901.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows irregular red cell agglutinates throughout the background, with scattered platelets and a small lymphocyte. Centrally there is a large mononuclear phagocyte with two overlapping nuclei and abundant grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm containing a small dense round nucleus and a few platelet fragments, indicating phagocytic activity. No blasts or organisms are identified. Findings are consistent with a circulating hemophagocytic cell in the setting of red cell agglutination, compatible with autoimmune (likely cold agglutinin-associated) hemolytic anemia; the markedly elevated MCV and MCHC reflect agglutination artifact.

ddx.vs: Occasional phagocytes alone are not diagnostic; HLH requires clinical and laboratory criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, sCD25).

ddx.dx: Neutrophil containing an apoptotic body (LE cell-like)
ddx.vs: The engulfing cell would have a segmented nucleus and neutrophilic granules rather than two oval nuclei and grey-blue monocytic cytoplasm.
Rouleaux form linear stacked-coin chains, whereas agglutinates are irregular three-dimensional clumps.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and granular cytoplasm budding platelets, and tumor cells lack phagocytosed material.

62837.recognize_zh: 骨小樑被挖出一個大吸收腔，左側與下方腔壁排著一整排多核蝕骨細胞，腔內充滿疏鬆纖維網狀基質與少量小圓細胞，右側骨小樑外的骨髓有脂肪與造血細胞；這種「蝕骨細胞鑽入骨小樑、腔內纖維化」的隧道狀吸收是副甲狀腺亢進骨病的表現。
features: Bony trabecula with a large internal resorption cavity opening toward the adjacent marrow (tunnelling resorption)
Multiple multinucleated osteoclasts with eosinophilic cytoplasm lining scalloped Howship's lacunae along the cavity wall
Cavity filled by loose, delicate fibrillary fibrous stroma with scattered small lymphoid/hematopoietic cells and a few fat vacuoles
Adjacent marrow on the right with fat spaces, red cells and hematopoietic elements
Lamellar bone of the trabecula otherwise intact with evenly spaced osteocyte lacunae
62837.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section (photographed through the eyepiece) shows a trabecula excavated by a large resorption cavity lined by numerous multinucleated osteoclasts in scalloped Howship's lacunae. The cavity contains loose fibrous stroma with scattered small cells and extends toward the adjacent marrow space, which shows fat and residual hematopoiesis. The pattern of dissecting resorption with fibrous replacement indicates high bone turnover. In a patient with chronic renal failure and hypocalcemia, findings are consistent with renal osteodystrophy due to secondary hyperparathyroidism (osteitis fibrosa).

ddx.vs: Histology is indistinguishable; serum calcium, phosphate and renal function separate primary from secondary disease.
Paget disease shows giant osteoclasts with dozens of nuclei and a mosaic cement-line pattern with osteoblastic rimming rather than fibrous tunnelling cavities.

ddx.dx: Brown tumor or giant cell lesion
ddx.vs: Brown tumors form expansile masses of osteoclast-like giant cells in hemorrhagic fibrous stroma with hemosiderin, rather than resorption confined within trabeculae.
Osteoclasts in tumor-related osteolysis abut neoplastic cells, whereas this cavity contains only bland fibrous stroma.

62773.recognize_zh: 骨髓中成片漿細胞 CD38 與 MUM1 強陽性，但 CD138 免疫染色與流式皆為陰性，流式另顯示 CD19−、CD45−、CD27−、CD56−、CD117− 並有胞質 kappa 限制，說明這是 CD138 陰性的漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Aspirate: plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof, and basophilic cytoplasm, including atypical and binucleate forms
Biopsy: sheets of plasmacytoid cells effacing the marrow (H&E)
IHC: CD138 negative; CD38 strong membranous positive; MUM1 strong nuclear positive
Flow: CD38-bright population (about 36% of events) lacking CD138
Flow: CD19-negative, CD45-negative, CD27-negative, CD56-negative, CD117-negative, with cytoplasmic kappa restriction
62773.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows increased plasma cells, including atypical and binucleate forms with eccentric nuclei and abundant basophilic cytoplasm. The core biopsy shows diffuse sheets of plasmacytoid cells replacing normal hematopoiesis. By immunohistochemistry the neoplastic cells are strongly positive for CD38 and MUM1 but negative for CD138. Flow cytometry confirms a CD38-bright, CD138-negative population that is CD19, CD45, CD27, CD56, and CD117 negative and shows cytoplasmic kappa light chain restriction. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with loss of CD138 expression.

ddx.vs: LPL contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with CD19/CD20-positive clonal B cells and MYD88 L265P, whereas this population is uniformly CD19-negative plasma cells.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shows large immunoblastic cells with prominent nucleoli, very high Ki-67, and frequent EBER positivity, typically in extramedullary sites with immunodeficiency.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic, retain CD19 and CD27, and do not form effacing sheets.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or other CD138-positive/negative round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Carcinoma is keratin-positive and forms cohesive nests, while this infiltrate expresses CD38, MUM1, and monotypic cytoplasmic kappa.

62773.stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E; IHC: CD138, CD38, MUM1; flow cytometry

62709.recognize_zh: 這是母細胞 gate 的 CD7 對 CD34 流式散點圖（dot plot）：大部分母細胞 CD34 陰性到弱陽性，只有一小群 CD34 強陽性；CD7 從弱到中度部分表現，沒有形成明確的 T 細胞族群。
features: Dot plot gated on blasts: CD7-APC700 (x) versus CD34-PC7 (y), log scales
Majority of blasts CD34 negative to dim (<10^3)
Minor subset CD34 bright (~10^4), predominantly CD7 negative
CD7 shows a continuous smear from negative to ~10^4 (partial dim-to-moderate expression)
No discrete CD7-bright population
62709.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of the blast gate displays CD7 versus CD34. The blasts are largely CD34 negative to dim with a minor CD34-bright subset, and show heterogeneous partial dim-to-moderate CD7 expression. CD7 is a nonspecific marker frequently aberrant in myeloid and mixed phenotype blasts and does not assign T lineage; cytoplasmic CD3 is required for that. Findings are compatible with an immature population with heterogeneous CD34 expression, as seen in the reported mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid.

ddx.vs: T lineage requires bright cytoplasmic CD3 (at the level of mature T cells), not CD7 expression alone.
ETP-ALL is cCD3 positive with CD7 typically bright, CD1a/CD8 negative and CD5 dim, plus stem/myeloid markers, whereas this population lacks bright CD7.
Separation from B/myeloid MPAL depends on B-lineage markers (strong CD19 with CD79a, CD22 or CD10), not on the CD7/CD34 pattern.

62581.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E（箭頭標示）：黑色箭頭指出大型中心母細胞（核圓、泡狀染色質、靠核膜的小核仁），藍色與白色箭頭指出較小、有角或裂紋核的中心細胞；視野中中心母細胞數量多（>15/高倍視野）但仍有中心細胞夾雜，並見分裂像，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤 3a 級。
features: Numerous centroblasts: large cells with round vesicular nuclei and 1-3 peripheral nucleoli (black arrows)
Admixed centrocytes: small to medium cells with angulated, cleaved nuclei (blue and white arrows)
Centroblasts exceed 15 per high-power field while centrocytes remain present
Scattered mitotic figures
Scant cytoplasm and monotonous germinal-center cell population without tingible body macrophages
62581.describe_en: High-power view of a neoplastic follicle shows a crowded population of germinal-center cells. Numerous centroblasts, large cells with round vesicular nuclei and one to three peripherally located nucleoli (black arrows), are admixed with centrocytes, small to medium cells with angulated and cleaved nuclei (blue and white arrows); scattered mitotic figures are present and tingible body macrophages are not seen. The centroblasts exceed 15 per high-power field, but centrocytes are still clearly present and there are no solid sheets of centroblasts. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma, grade 3a.

ddx.vs: Grade 3b follicles are composed of solid sheets of centroblasts without admixed centrocytes.
Low-grade FL contains 15 or fewer centroblasts per high-power field with a predominance of centrocytes.
DLBCL shows diffuse sheets of large cells without follicular architecture or follicular dendritic cell meshworks (CD21/CD23).
Reactive germinal centers show polarization, abundant tingible body macrophages and BCL2-negative germinal-center cells.

62517.recognize_zh: 下方為淡染、顆粒狀的壞死區，壞死邊緣有一圈細長、放射狀排列的柵欄狀組織球，外層是淋巴球浸潤帶，上方可見纖維化被膜；此分層結構符合貓抓病的壞死性肉芽腫。
features: Central pale granular necrotic zone with fibrinous debris at the lower field
Band of elongated epithelioid histiocytes palisading radially around the necrosis
Outer cuff of dense small lymphocytes
Fibrotic, vascularized capsular/perinodal tissue in the upper left
Focal hemorrhage at the edge of the necrotic area
62517.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a zonated necrotizing granuloma. A central zone of pale granular necrosis is bordered by a layer of palisading epithelioid histiocytes, which is in turn surrounded by a cuff of small lymphocytes and fibrotic capsular tissue. Neutrophils within the necrotic center cannot be clearly resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with necrotizing granulomatous lymphadenitis, compatible with cat scratch disease; confirmation requires Warthin-Starry staining, serology, or PCR for Bartonella henselae.

ddx.vs: Caseating granulomas typically contain Langhans giant cells and lack stellate suppurative centers, with positive AFB stain or culture.
Kikuchi necrosis is karyorrhectic and paracortical with crescentic histiocytes, without neutrophils or palisading epithelioid histiocytes.
LGV produces identical stellate abscesses, so separation depends on inguinal location and Chlamydia serology or PCR.

62453.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆小到中型淋巴球，核幾乎佔滿細胞，染色質緻密且呈扭曲、摺疊的粗紋理，細胞質極少，與蕈狀肉芽腫血液侵犯時的小型 Sézary 細胞相符；核溝紋細微，需以流式細胞儀佐證。
features: Small to medium-sized lymphoid cell with very high N:C ratio
Round nuclear outline with dense, hyperchromatic chromatin showing convoluted, coiled texture suggestive of subtle grooves
No visible nucleolus
Scant rim of basophilic cytoplasm with a small peripheral bleb
Background normocytic red cells, a platelet clump and scattered platelets
62453.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small to medium-sized lymphoid cell with a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, a nucleus with dense, convoluted chromatin suggesting fine grooves, no visible nucleolus, and a scant rim of basophilic cytoplasm. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. The appearance is suggestive of a small Sezary cell, although cerebriform detail is subtle at this resolution. Findings are consistent with circulating neoplastic T cells in the setting of mycosis fungoides, pending confirmation by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Normal lymphocytes have smooth, round nuclei with homogeneous clumped chromatin, lacking the coiled grooved pattern, and show a normal CD4:CD8 ratio with preserved CD7/CD26.
CLL cells show 'soccer-ball' block chromatin with smudge cells and a clonal CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.
ATLL cells are polylobated 'flower cells' and are HTLV-1 positive and CD25 positive.
T-PLL cells have a prominent nucleolus, cytoplasmic blebs, marked lymphocytosis, and TCL1 overexpression.

62389.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結內充滿大小不一、背靠背排列的濾泡，生發中心大而淡染，外圍有清楚的深藍色套層（mantle zone）包覆，濾泡間區也保存；這是反應性濾泡增生（follicular hyperplasia）的樣式，於 IgG4 相關淋巴結病變中常見，需配合 IgG4/IgG 染色。
features: Numerous enlarged secondary follicles of variable size and shape
Large pale-staining germinal centers
Well-defined, intact dark mantle zones surrounding each follicle
Preserved interfollicular areas with small vessels
Mild interfollicular sclerosis/eosinophilic stroma, subtle at this magnification
62389.describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node shows numerous enlarged secondary lymphoid follicles of varying size with large, pale germinal centers and well-defined, intact mantle zones. The interfollicular areas are preserved and contain small vessels, with only subtle stromal sclerosis at this magnification. There is no back-to-back crowding with loss of mantle zones or capsular breach in this field. The findings represent reactive follicular hyperplasia, which in the appropriate clinical and immunohistochemical context (increased IgG4+ plasma cells with high IgG4/IgG ratio) may reflect IgG4-related lymphadenopathy.

ddx.vs: FL shows crowded monotonous follicles with attenuated mantles, lack of polarization and tingible-body macrophages, and BCL2-positive germinal centers.
These also show florid follicular hyperplasia with plasmacytosis, so separation depends on serology, capsular fibrosis with endarteritis (syphilis) and IgG4 counts.

ddx.dx: Castleman disease (hyaline vascular / plasma cell type)
ddx.vs: Castleman disease shows regressed germinal centers with onion-skin mantles and penetrating hyalinized vessels or sheets of interfollicular plasma cells.

62325.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中許多紅血球邊緣有半圓形缺口（咬痕細胞 bite cell），部分紅血球血紅素偏向一側、另一側淡染或呈水泡狀，還有少數不規則收縮的細胞，旁邊一顆正常嗜中性球作大小對照，是氧化性溶血的表現。
features: Numerous bite cells (keratocyte-like red cells with one or more semicircular peripheral defects)
Occasional blister cells / hemighost-like cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side
Scattered helmet-shaped and irregularly contracted dense red cells
Some larger, slightly grayer red cells suggesting polychromasia
Normal-appearing segmented neutrophil; platelets present, no schistocyte-predominant picture
62325.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous bite cells with semicircular peripheral defects, along with occasional blister cells in which hemoglobin is retracted to one side, helmet-shaped forms and irregularly contracted red cells. Scattered larger, slightly bluish red cells suggest polychromasia. A morphologically normal segmented neutrophil is present, and platelets are seen. Findings are consistent with oxidative hemolysis, such as G6PD deficiency or oxidant drug exposure; a supravital stain for Heinz bodies and G6PD assay (after the acute episode) are recommended.

ddx.vs: MAHA shows predominant fragmented schistocytes (triangles, helmets, microspherocytes) with thrombocytopenia, rather than bite and blister cells with hemoglobin retraction.

ddx.dx: Hereditary spherocytosis / warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia
ddx.vs: Spherocytic hemolysis shows round dense cells lacking central pallor without bite defects or eccentric hemoglobin, and AIHA is DAT-positive.
Unstable hemoglobins also cause Heinz bodies and bite cells, so hemoglobin electrophoresis/isopropanol stability testing with a normal G6PD level separates them.
Artifact produces crenated or refractile cells uniformly in one area of the smear, not true semicircular bites with eccentric hemoglobin distribution.

62133.recognize_zh: 抹片與切片中黑色箭頭指出胞質呈皺紙樣纖維狀（crumpled tissue paper）的大型 Gaucher 細胞，藍色箭頭指出漿細胞；CD138 免疫染色顯示成群漿細胞，表示 Gaucher 病合併漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale blue fibrillary cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei (Gaucher cells, black arrows, A-B)
Admixed plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm (blue arrows)
Hypercellular marrow with sheets of pale Gaucher cells replacing fat on H&E (C, E)
CD138 immunostain highlighting increased clusters and sheets of plasma cells (D)
Dark chromogenic stain highlighting clustered cells (F), likely light-chain in situ hybridization
62133.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (A) shows large histiocytes with abundant fibrillary, crumpled tissue paper-like cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei, admixed with plasma cells. The trephine biopsy (B, C, E) shows interstitial and sheet-like infiltrates of pale Gaucher cells with interspersed plasma cells. CD138 immunohistochemistry (D) highlights increased plasma cells in clusters and sheets, and an additional chromogenic stain (F) highlights clustered cells, likely representing light-chain in situ hybridization. Findings are consistent with Gaucher disease with concurrent plasma cell myeloma; clonality should be confirmed by kappa/lambda studies and serum protein electrophoresis.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in chronic myeloid leukemia or myeloma
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically similar but arise from high cell turnover with normal glucocerebrosidase activity, whereas true Gaucher disease shows enzyme deficiency and GBA1 mutations.

ddx.dx: Reactive polyclonal plasmacytosis in Gaucher disease
ddx.vs: Gaucher disease commonly has polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia with scattered plasma cells, whereas myeloma shows sheets of CD138-positive cells with light-chain restriction.
