Mycobacterium avium-laden histiocytes can appear striated but are acid-fast positive with granular rather than fibrillary PAS pattern.
Niemann-Pick foam cells have bubbly lipid vacuoles rather than fibrillary crumpled tissue paper cytoplasm.

62133.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD138; ISH (likely light chain)

62005.recognize_zh: 雙畫面超音波：左圖未加壓時可見右膕靜脈（RT Pop V）與膕動脈（A）；右圖加壓後靜脈只被部分壓扁（Partial Comp），仍殘留管腔，靜脈不能完全壓扁即是深部靜脈血栓（DVT）的關鍵徵象。
features: Side-by-side B-mode (grayscale) ultrasound of the right popliteal fossa
Left panel (no compression): hypoechoic right popliteal vein (RT Pop V) adjacent to the popliteal artery (A)
Right panel (with compression): vein only partially compressible, with persistent residual lumen
Incomplete venous compressibility is the primary sonographic criterion for DVT
Intraluminal echogenic thrombus is not clearly resolved at this image quality
Non-morphologic image: chronicity is inferred clinically, not from this frame
62005.describe_en: Paired grayscale compression ultrasound images of the right popliteal fossa show the popliteal vein adjacent to the popliteal artery. With probe compression, the vein is only partially compressible and retains a residual lumen, indicating intraluminal thrombus. Discrete echogenic thrombus is not clearly resolved on this still image, and Doppler flow is not shown. Findings are consistent with partially occlusive deep vein thrombosis of the right popliteal vein; features favoring chronicity (echogenic, retracted, wall-adherent thrombus, collaterals) are not assessable here.

ddx.vs: Acute thrombus is typically hypoechoic and expands a noncompressible vein, whereas chronic thrombus is echogenic, retracted, wall-adherent and associated with a contracted vein, collaterals or synechiae.
A Baker cyst is an anechoic collection separate from the vein, communicating between the gastrocnemius and semimembranosus tendons, with a fully compressible adjacent vein.
An aneurysm is a pulsatile dilated artery with arterial Doppler flow and mural thrombus, while the adjacent vein compresses normally.

61941.recognize_zh: 低倍IgD染色下一個巨大、不規則的結節被IgD陽性小B細胞填滿，其中散布數個淡染、IgD陰性的生發中心殘島，旁邊另有一個較小的IgD陽性結節，是IgD+外套細胞侵入並瓦解生發中心的PTGC圖像。
features: Very large, irregular nodule diffusely populated by IgD-positive small B cells
Multiple pale, IgD-negative islands representing fragmented residual germinal centers
Smaller adjacent IgD-positive nodule at the right edge
IgD-negative interfollicular/paracortical zones surrounding the nodule
Capsule visible at the lower left
61941.describe_en: Low-power IgD immunostain of lymph node shows a very large irregular nodule diffusely populated by IgD-positive small mantle B cells, within which several pale IgD-negative islands of residual germinal center are dispersed. A smaller IgD-positive nodule lies nearby, and the surrounding paracortex is largely IgD-negative. The expansion of IgD-positive mantle cells into and around fragmented germinal centers is characteristic of progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: NLPHL nodules are also rich in IgD+ small B cells, so the discriminator is the presence of LP cells (CD20+/OCT2+) with PD1+ rosettes and CD21+ FDC meshworks expanded throughout the node.
MCL nodules are cyclin D1/SOX11 and CD5-positive monotypic B cells, often with naked germinal centers rather than fragmented germinal-center islands.
FL shows crowded neoplastic follicles with little IgD+ mantle and BCL2+/CD10+ germinal center cells.

61877.recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖中紅色原始細胞群 cMPO、cCD79a、CD19、CD34 皆陰性，而 CD7 強陽性、胞質與表面 CD3 陽性，並表現 CD1a、CD2、CD5、CD99，且 CD4 與 CD8 共同陽性，呈皮質胸腺細胞表型，確立 T 淋巴母細胞白血病/淋巴瘤（T-ALL/LBL）。
features: Blast gate (red, P5) negative for cytoplasmic MPO and cytoplasmic CD79a, and CD19 negative
CD34 negative blasts
Bright CD7 with cytoplasmic CD3 positivity and variable surface CD3 expression
CD1a, CD2 and CD5 positive
CD99 positive, supporting immaturity
CD4/CD8 double-positive population, a cortical thymocyte phenotype
61877.describe_en: Multiparameter flow cytometry plots show that the abnormal blast population (red) is negative for lineage-defining myeloid and B-cell markers (cytoplasmic MPO, cytoplasmic CD79a, CD19) and for CD34. The blasts express bright CD7, cytoplasmic CD3 with variable surface CD3, CD2, CD5, CD1a and CD99, and show CD4 and CD8 co-expression. Residual normal lymphocytes (blue) and granulocytes (green) serve as internal controls. This cortical thymocyte immunophenotype is diagnostic of T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, cortical stage, and explains the Burkitt-like vacuolated blasts seen morphologically.

ddx.vs: ETP-ALL is CD1a and CD8 negative with dim or absent CD5 and expresses stem/myeloid markers (CD34, CD117, HLA-DR, CD13/CD33), unlike these CD1a-positive, CD4/CD8 double-positive blasts.
Thymocytes in thymoma show a smeared, continuous maturation pattern of CD4/CD8 and CD3 without aberrant antigen loss, and occur with an epithelial thymic mass.
Mature T-cell neoplasms are TdT, CD1a and CD99 negative with surface CD3, and are usually CD4 or CD8 single positive.
T/myeloid MPAL requires myeloid lineage evidence such as MPO expression, which is negative here.

61813.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的細胞團中可見一顆巨核細胞，細胞質內散布多個分離的圓形核（類似散落的棋子），周圍有顆粒球系前驅細胞與脂肪空泡，為典型的多核發育不良巨核細胞。
features: Megakaryocyte with numerous discrete, separated round nuclei within shared basophilic cytoplasm
Nuclei of similar size with moderately condensed chromatin
Surrounding granulocytic precursors and neutrophils, some with hypogranular cytoplasm
Occasional erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei
Multiple fat vacuoles within a cellular particle
61813.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with fat vacuoles containing a megakaryocyte with numerous discrete, separated round nuclei in a shared basophilic cytoplasm. The surrounding marrow includes granulocytic precursors, neutrophils and erythroid precursors, some granulocytes appearing hypogranular. Megakaryocytes with multiple separated nuclei are a defining dysplastic feature when present in at least 10% of megakaryocytes. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia in a myeloid neoplasm associated with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain many uniform nuclei with prominent nucleoli and granular pink-purple cytoplasm, and are usually found near bone spicules.
Reactive megakaryocytes have a single polylobated nucleus with connected lobes.
Megaloblastic marrow shows hypersegmented megakaryocyte nuclei with open chromatin plus megaloblastic erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes.

61749.recognize_zh: 標示為 CD20 的染色中，中央一團小淋巴球結節的細胞核與膜幾乎沒有棕色染色，只有結節內零星、細網狀的淡棕色訊號；這與脾邊緣區淋巴瘤應有的強 CD20 陽性不符，可能是標示錯誤或為其他陰性標記。
features: Nodular aggregate of small uniform lymphoid cells surrounded by spindled stroma
Lymphoid cells are essentially unstained (no membranous positivity)
Faint, fine granular/reticular brown signal confined to the nodule, resembling a dendritic meshwork pattern
Background stromal cells negative
61749.describe_en: Immunohistochemistry labeled as CD20 shows a nodular aggregate of small lymphoid cells in which the lymphoid cells lack membranous staining, with only faint, fine reticular brown signal within the nodule and a negative spindled background. This pattern contradicts the strong membranous CD20 positivity expected in splenic marginal zone lymphoma. The image is discordant with its label and more likely represents a negative or dendritic-cell-restricted marker (such as CD23 or CD21 staining a follicular dendritic meshwork) or a failed stain; correlation with the case's actual CD20 slide is required.

ddx.vs: A fine reticular signal between unstained lymphocytes is the pattern of FDC markers, not of membranous CD20 on B cells.
After anti-CD20 therapy, B cells may lose CD20 but remain PAX5/CD79a-positive.
A CD20-negative nodule could be T-cell rich, which would be confirmed by CD3 positivity and PAX5 negativity.

61685.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（CD8 對 CD4），非形態影像；主要藍色族群 CD8 強陽性並同時帶有弱至中度 CD4，呈 CD4/CD8 共表現的樣式，與旁邊正常的 CD4 單陽性（紅）及 CD8 單陽性（洋紅）族群不同。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD8-ECD (x-axis) versus CD4-APC750 (y-axis), gate labeled [AZ]
Dominant blue population with bright CD8 (about 10^2) and CD4 expression ranging from dim to moderate (about 10^0 to 10^1.5)
Small red CD4-positive, CD8-negative population consistent with residual normal CD4 T cells
Magenta CD8-bright, CD4-negative events adjacent to the blue cluster, consistent with residual CD8 T cells
Green/magenta CD4-negative to dim, CD8-negative events at lower left
61685.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot displays CD8 versus CD4 expression within the gated population. The dominant population (blue) expresses bright CD8 with a continuum of dim to moderate CD4, indicating CD4/CD8 co-expression, and is distinct from the small residual CD4 single-positive (red) and CD8 single-positive (magenta) populations. A double-negative group of events is present at the lower left. CD4 and CD8 co-expression by a mature expanded T-cell population is seen in about a quarter of cases of T-prolymphocytic leukemia and is rare in other mature T-cell leukemias, supporting the given diagnosis.

61621.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片可見明顯增多、呈叢狀的紅血球前驅細胞（核圓深染、核周淡染），巨核細胞形態大致正常並散布於脂肪之間，提示以紅血球系為主的增生；環狀鐵粒母細胞需鐵染色確認。
features: Increased erythroid precursors forming clusters, with round dark nuclei and perinuclear clearing
Megakaryocytes of normal to slightly variable size, mostly lobulated, scattered
Maturing granulocytic elements present
Normocellular to mildly hypercellular marrow with interspersed fat
No obvious increase in blasts; ring sideroblasts not evaluable on H&E
61621.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a normocellular to mildly hypercellular marrow with interspersed fat. Erythroid precursors are increased and form clusters of cells with round, dark nuclei and perinuclear clearing, while granulocytic maturation is present and megakaryocytes are scattered with largely unremarkable lobation. Blasts are not conspicuously increased. The erythroid-predominant picture is compatible with MDS with ring sideroblasts and single-lineage dysplasia, which must be confirmed by iron stain for ring sideroblasts and SF3B1 mutation analysis.

ddx.vs: Reactive erythroid hyperplasia shows orderly erythroid maturation without dyserythropoiesis or ring sideroblasts, with appropriate reticulocytosis.
Megaloblastic change shows enlarged erythroid precursors with open chromatin and giant metamyelocytes, correctable by B12/folate.
Separation requires dysplasia in ≥10% of cells of ≥2 lineages, best assessed on the aspirate rather than on H&E sections.

61493.recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間的造血組織中散在多顆大型巨核細胞，細胞質豐富、核分葉，數量看起來增加但未形成緊密聚集，也沒有纖維化或異常浸潤，搭配臨床血小板低下符合免疫性血小板減少症（ITP）的骨髓表現。
features: Increased numbers of large megakaryocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm scattered singly through the marrow space
Megakaryocyte nuclei lobated without obvious hyperchromatic, bulbous or cloud-like atypia; no tight clusters at this power
Cellular marrow with admixed erythroid and granulocytic precursors and interspersed fat spaces
Two bony trabeculae present; no fibrosis, granulomas or abnormal lymphoid aggregates evident
Section is fragmented with some crush/retraction artifact at the edges
61493.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section shows cellular hematopoietic marrow between bony trabeculae, with trilineage hematopoiesis and interspersed adipocytes. Megakaryocytes appear increased in number and are distributed singly without tight clustering; they are large with abundant cytoplasm and lobated nuclei lacking marked atypia. No fibrosis, granulomas or infiltrating neoplastic population is identified in this field, although the section is fragmented. In the setting of isolated thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with a peripheral consumptive process such as immune thrombocytopenia (ITP).

ddx.vs: MPN shows large hyperlobulated or atypical megakaryocytes in loose clusters with a high platelet count, whereas ITP has non-clustered, morphologically unremarkable megakaryocytes with thrombocytopenia.
MDS megakaryocytes are small hypolobated or separated-lobe forms with dyspoiesis in other lineages, not the normal-appearing large megakaryocytes seen here.
Marrow can look identical; distinction relies on lifelong history, giant platelets on smear, family history and genetic testing rather than biopsy morphology.

61429.recognize_zh: 臨床照片見上顎牙齦邊界清楚的潰瘍（A），切片為黏膜潰瘍下方的多形性浸潤並含散在大型異型細胞（B、C），免疫染色見大型細胞群（D–F），EBER 原位雜交大量核陽性（G），符合 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍（EBVMCU）。
features: Clinical photo (A): sharply circumscribed ulcer of the maxillary gingiva
Low power (B): superficial mucosal biopsy with surface ulceration and a band-like infiltrate
High power (C): polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and plasma cells with scattered large atypical immunoblast-like cells
IHC (D-F): numerous positive large cells, with a denser band of positive cells at the base in D (antibodies not labeled)
EBER ISH (G): many positive nuclei of varying size scattered in the infiltrate
61429.describe_en: Composite figure: clinical photograph shows a well-circumscribed gingival ulcer. The biopsy shows mucosal ulceration overlying a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasma cells and histiocytes with scattered large atypical immunoblastic cells. Immunohistochemical panels highlight numerous large cells (specific antibodies not labeled), and EBER in situ hybridization shows many EBV-positive nuclei of variable size. In the appropriate setting of immunosuppression, findings are consistent with EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer.

ddx.vs: cHL shows Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD15+ and CD20/OCT2 weak or negative with systemic nodal disease, whereas EBVMCU cells often retain B-cell programme and form a self-limited circumscribed ulcer.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: EBV+ DLBCL forms a mass with sheets of large cells and lacks the sharp circumscription and basal rim of small T cells characteristic of EBVMCU.
ENKTL is angiocentric and necrotic with EBER-positive CD3e+/CD56+ cells rather than B-cell immunoblasts.
Reactive ulcers lack large atypical CD30+ immunoblasts with abundant EBER positivity.

61429.stain: H&E; IHC (antibodies unlabeled); ISH: EBER; clinical photo

61301.recognize_zh: 這是毛細管區帶血紅素電泳圖：除 Hb A（61.6%）外，在 Z(D) 區出現一個大峰 Hb D（35.3%），Hb A2 3.1% 正常，未見 Hb S 或 Hb F 峰，符合異型合子血紅素 D 的圖形。
features: Capillary zone electrophoresis tracing with labeled migration zones
Dominant Hb A peak in Z(A) at 61.6%
Second large peak in Z(D) labeled Hb D at 35.3%
Hb A2 peak in Z(A2) at 3.1%, within normal range
No peaks in Z(S), Z(F), Z(C), or Z(E)
61301.describe_en: Capillary zone hemoglobin electrophoresis shows Hb A 61.6%, a variant peak in the D zone of 35.3%, and Hb A2 3.1%, with no Hb S, Hb F, Hb C, or Hb E peak. The proportion of the variant (about one-third of total hemoglobin) is typical of a heterozygous beta-chain variant. The pattern is consistent with hemoglobin D trait, most commonly Hb D-Punjab (Los Angeles), a beta-121 Glu→Gln substitution. Confirmation with an alternative method (HPLC or acid electrophoresis, where Hb D separates from Hb S) or DNA sequencing is advisable, particularly for family counseling given interaction with Hb S.

ddx.vs: Hb S migrates in the Z(S) zone, is positive on sickle solubility testing, and separates from Hb D on acid electrophoresis.
Alpha-chain variants usually comprise about 20-25% and produce a variant A2 peak (G2), whereas beta-chain Hb D is about 35-40% with a normal A2.
Hb Lepore is present at only about 10% and elutes near the A2 zone with microcytosis.

61237.recognize_zh: 九格組圖中同時出現多種形態的肥大細胞：核偏心或雙葉、細胞質含粗大紫紅色顆粒（F、E）、部分顆粒稀少呈淡染泡沫狀（A–C），以及梭形具突起的顆粒化細胞（G–I），呈現非典型肥大細胞的形態譜。
features: Panels A-C: medium-to-large cells with eccentric, bilobed or kidney-shaped nuclei and pale, hypogranular to vacuolated ('foamy') cytoplasm with sparse fine granules
Panel B/E: clusters of cells with abundant cytoplasm containing scattered purple metachromatic granules, admixed with granulocytes
Panel F: round cell densely packed with coarse purple-red granules obscuring a central nucleus, typical of a well-granulated mast cell
Panel D: small hypogranular cell with a round dense nucleus and a thin rim of cytoplasm bearing few peripheral granules
Panels G-I: spindle-shaped/elongated cells with cytoplasmic tails filled with coarse dark granules (atypical spindled mast cells)
61237.describe_en: Composite of Wright-Giemsa-stained smears shows a spectrum of mast cell morphologies. Many cells are atypical, with eccentric or bilobed (promastocyte-like) nuclei and hypogranular, pale to vacuolated 'foamy' cytoplasm containing only sparse metachromatic granules, alongside classic round mast cells packed with coarse purple granules and spindle-shaped cells with granule-laden cytoplasmic extensions. The hypogranular forms can be mistaken for monocytes or dysplastic granulocytes. In the setting of systemic mastocytosis, a predominance of immature atypical mast cells in the aspirate supports mast cell leukemia; confirmation requires quantifying mast cells (>=20% of aspirate nucleated cells), tryptase, CD117/CD25 flow or IHC, and KIT mutation testing.

ddx.vs: Promyelocytes have bilobed nuclei with azurophilic granules and Auer rod bundles, are MPO strongly positive and tryptase negative, whereas mast cells show metachromatic, tryptase-positive granules.
Basophils have segmented nuclei and water-soluble granules overlying the nucleus and are CD123+/CD203c+ but lack the spindled forms and tryptase-high, CD25+ phenotype of neoplastic mast cells.
Monocytic cells have folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and are NSE/CD14 positive but tryptase/CD117-bright negative.

61173.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下可見兩個多核巨細胞，細胞核排列在周邊呈馬蹄形（Langhans giant cell），周圍有細胞核呈橢圓、染色質淡的上皮樣組織球與小淋巴球，無乾酪樣壞死，符合類肉瘤（sarcoidosis）肉芽腫。
features: Multinucleated giant cells with numerous nuclei arranged at the periphery in a horseshoe/wreath pattern (Langhans type)
Abundant pale eosinophilic, finely granular to vacuolated giant-cell cytoplasm
Surrounding epithelioid histiocytes with elongated, oval, vesicular nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Small mature lymphocytes cuffing the granuloma
No caseous necrosis, asteroid bodies, Schaumann bodies or visible organisms in this field
61173.describe_en: Lymph node section at high power shows a granulomatous focus composed of epithelioid histiocytes with elongated vesicular nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Two large multinucleated giant cells of Langhans type are present, with nuclei arranged peripherally in a horseshoe configuration. Small lymphocytes surround the granuloma. No necrosis, asteroid bodies, Schaumann bodies, or microorganisms are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with non-necrotizing granulomatous inflammation; in the appropriate clinical context and after exclusion of infection with special stains and cultures, this is compatible with sarcoidosis.

ddx.vs: Mycobacterial granulomas typically show central caseous necrosis and may contain AFB-positive bacilli, which are absent here; stains and culture are needed for exclusion.
Fungal granulomas often have necrosis and contain yeasts demonstrable on GMS/PAS stains.
Foreign-body giant cells have haphazardly scattered nuclei and contain polarizable or visible foreign material, unlike the peripheral horseshoe nuclei here.

ddx.dx: Sarcoid-like reaction to lymphoma or carcinoma
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar granulomas can accompany Hodgkin lymphoma or metastatic carcinoma, so the node must be searched for Reed-Sternberg or tumor cells.

61109.recognize_zh: 眼眶 CT 在右側眼眶外上方見軟組織腫塊（箭頭，A）；切片中淚腺腺泡之間被瀰漫的中型母細胞樣細胞浸潤（B），一種染色僅少數細胞胞質陽性（C、D），另一種核染色則瀰漫強陽性（E），提示急性白血病在眼眶以髓外腫塊形式復發，需免疫組化判定混合譜系。
features: Axial CT: soft-tissue mass in the superolateral right orbit (lacrimal region), arrow
Diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized cells with high N:C ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei and fine chromatin, separating lacrimal gland acini
Residual benign glandular acini and ducts entrapped within the infiltrate
Immunostains C and D: cytoplasmic granular positivity in only a minority of scattered cells (antigens not labeled)
Immunostain E: diffuse strong nuclear positivity in the vast majority of infiltrating cells (antigen not labeled)
61109.describe_en: Composite figure. Axial CT demonstrates a soft-tissue mass in the superolateral right orbit. Biopsy of the lacrimal gland region shows a diffuse infiltrate of monotonous medium-sized blast-like cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and fine chromatin, infiltrating between and around benign acini. Two immunostains show cytoplasmic positivity in only a minority of cells, whereas a nuclear marker is diffusely and strongly positive in the neoplastic population. Because the antigens are not labeled, lineage assignment cannot be made from the figure alone; in the clinical context, the findings are consistent with extramedullary relapse of mixed-phenotype acute leukemia (myeloid sarcoma-like presentation) in the orbit.

ddx.dx: Ocular adnexal extranodal marginal zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma is composed of small mature marginal zone B cells with plasmacytic differentiation, not blasts with fine chromatin that express TdT/CD34 or MPO.
Pure myeloid sarcoma lacks co-expression of a second lineage (e.g., cytoplasmic CD3 or strong CD19 with CD79a/PAX5), which is required for mixed-phenotype designation.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma is TdT+ with B or T lineage markers but lacks MPO or monocytic differentiation.

ddx.dx: Rhabdomyosarcoma / small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Orbital rhabdomyosarcoma is desmin/myogenin-positive and CD45-negative, whereas leukemic infiltrates are CD45+ with hematopoietic lineage markers.

61045.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球系與骨髓系前驅細胞的胞質有許多細小空泡（cytoplasmic vacuolization），鐵染色可見藍綠色鐵顆粒環繞細胞核的環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts），嬰兒合併骨髓衰竭即應想到 Pearson 症候群。
features: Myeloid and erythroid precursors with prominent small, punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles
Vacuoles concentrated at the cytoplasmic periphery of an erythroid precursor and a promyelocyte-like cell
Prussian blue stain: erythroblasts with coarse blue-green iron granules encircling the nucleus (ring sideroblasts)
Additional non-ring iron granules scattered in the background
61045.describe_en: Composite of bone marrow aspirate smears. On Wright-Giemsa stain, granulocytic and erythroid precursors show conspicuous cytoplasmic vacuolization. Prussian blue iron stain demonstrates ring sideroblasts, with iron granules encircling at least one third of the nuclear circumference. In an infant with marrow failure, findings are consistent with Pearson marrow-pancreas syndrome (mitochondrial DNA deletion), which should be confirmed by mtDNA deletion analysis.

ddx.vs: Morphology is similar (vacuoles plus ring sideroblasts) but occurs in older patients with low serum copper/ceruloplasmin and no mtDNA deletion.
Drug/alcohol-induced vacuolization has an exposure history and resolves on withdrawal.
These cause ring sideroblasts with microcytosis but lack precursor vacuolization and pancreatic insufficiency.
MDS-RS occurs in older adults with SF3B1 mutation and lacks prominent vacuolization.

60981.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑明顯增厚、互相連結成網（骨硬化），小樑間髓腔幾乎沒有造血細胞，只剩淡粉紅色纖維化基質與散在脂肪，符合纖維化期原發性骨髓纖維化的「燃盡」骨髓。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular and anastomosing bony trabeculae occupying much of the core (osteosclerosis)
Intertrabecular spaces replaced by pale, loose-to-fibrillary eosinophilic fibrotic stroma with dilated sinusoids
Scattered fat vacuoles; overall cellularity very low with only rare residual hematopoietic cells
No discernible megakaryocyte clusters or blasts at this magnification
Low-power view only; fibrosis grade requires reticulin/trichrome stains
60981.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows marked osteosclerosis with broad, irregular, interconnecting trabeculae. The intertrabecular marrow is severely hypocellular (<5%) and replaced by pale fibrotic stroma with scattered adipocytes, sinusoidal ectasia and only minimal residual hematopoiesis. No atypical megakaryocyte clusters or blast aggregates are appreciated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with advanced (fibrotic stage) myelofibrosis with osteosclerosis; reticulin and trichrome stains are recommended for grading.

ddx.dx: Post-polycythemia vera or post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis
ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable burnt-out marrow; separation depends on the documented prior MPN history.
Hypocellular marrow is fatty with normal-thickness trabeculae and no stromal fibrosis or osteosclerosis.
Shows cohesive epithelial tumor nests (keratin-positive) within the fibrosis, which are not seen here.
Features peritrabecular fibrosis with active osteoclastic resorption (dissecting osteitis) while intertrabecular hematopoiesis is preserved.

60917.recognize_zh: 抹片中出現中至大型、染色質細緻像芽細胞的淋巴樣細胞，切片為成片的中大型細胞，免疫染色呈瀰漫但沿竇狀隙排列的陽性，FISH 以 7 號著絲點與 7q31 探針評估 7q 拷貝數（等臂染色體 7q），在克隆氏症病人應想到肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤的芽細胞樣變異。
features: Aspirate: medium-to-large blastoid lymphoid cells with fine chromatin, round to slightly irregular nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Biopsy H&E: sheets of medium-to-large cells with vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm
IHC: extensive positivity of the infiltrate with a cord-like/sinusoidal distribution at low power (marker not labeled)
FISH with centromere 7 (green) and 7q31 (red) probes on interphase nuclei to assess 7q gain/isochromosome 7q
60917.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows medium-to-large blastoid lymphoid cells with fine chromatin, slightly irregular nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm. The trephine biopsy is extensively infiltrated by sheets of similar cells with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli. An immunostain highlights the neoplastic cells diffusely with a cord-like, sinusoidal-appearing pattern. Interphase FISH using centromere 7 and 7q31 probes is performed to detect isochromosome 7q, although signal enumeration is limited at this image resolution. In a young patient with Crohn disease on immunosuppression, the findings are consistent with hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma with blastoid morphology, pending confirmation of a CD3+/CD5-/CD4-/CD8- cytotoxic γδ (or αβ) T-cell phenotype.

ddx.vs: T-LBL cells express TdT and often CD1a/CD34 with cytoplasmic CD3, whereas HSTCL is TdT-negative, CD5-negative and TIA-1 positive with i(7q).
Myeloid blasts are MPO/CD33/CD117 positive and lack T-cell antigens.
T-LGL cells are small with abundant cytoplasm and azurophilic granules, show interstitial linear clusters and have an indolent course without i(7q).
Surface CD3 negative, EBV (EBER) positive, typically in young Asian patients, and lacks TCR gene rearrangement.

60853.recognize_zh: Langerin（CD207）免疫染色中，上方大型、胞質豐富的病灶細胞群呈強烈的顆粒狀胞質與膜染色，與下方陰性的小淋巴球區域界線分明，langerin 陽性確認為蘭格漢斯細胞，支持 LCH。
features: Aggregates of large lesional cells at the top of the field with strong granular cytoplasmic and membranous langerin staining
Lesional cells with abundant cytoplasm and pale, oval to grooved nuclei visible through the stain
Sharp demarcation from surrounding langerin-negative small lymphocytes
Faint nonspecific staining in a germinal center-like area at lower center
Aggregates located in sinus/interfollicular compartments
60853.describe_en: Langerin (CD207) immunohistochemistry on a lymph node shows aggregates of large lesional cells with abundant cytoplasm that display strong granular cytoplasmic and membranous staining, sharply separated from the surrounding negative small lymphocytes. Only weak background staining is present in a lower germinal center-like area. Strong langerin expression confirms Langerhans cell lineage, consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis involving the lymph node.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are langerin and CD1a negative and S-100 positive with emperipolesis.
Indeterminate cell tumors are CD1a and S-100 positive but langerin negative and lack Birbeck granules.
These histiocytes are CD68/CD163/factor XIIIa positive and CD1a/langerin negative.

60789.recognize_zh: 骨組織切片中大型腫瘤細胞呈片狀，CD20 在細胞膜呈強而完整的棕色環狀陽性，核大且淡、含小核仁，右下角可見藍紫色骨小樑，證實是侵犯骨頭的大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Sheets of large cells with strong, complete membranous CD20 staining
Large oval vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli visible in the counterstain
Small capillaries and stromal cells negative for CD20
Bone trabecula at lower right (decalcified, purple-blue) adjacent to the infiltrate
Some crush/edge artifact at the tissue margin
60789.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry on a bone biopsy shows diffuse sheets of large lymphoid cells with strong, crisp membranous staining. The nuclei are large and vesicular with small nucleoli, and intervening capillaries and stromal cells are negative. A bony trabecula is present at the lower right, adjacent to the infiltrate. Together with the centroblastic H&E morphology, findings are consistent with primary bone diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or plasma cell myeloma
ddx.vs: Large cells are CD20 negative and CD138/MUM1 positive.
HRS cells are scattered and CD20 weak or negative rather than forming CD20-strong sheets.
CD20 may be positive, but cells are medium with fine chromatin and express TdT/CD34.

60597.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個巨噬細胞內含十多個酵母菌，每個菌體被寬大透明的暈圈（莢膜）包圍、中央菌體呈不規則月牙或變形的紫色小塊，大小不一，符合新型隱球菌（Cryptococcus）。
features: Macrophage with a round nucleus and abundant finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Numerous intracellular yeast forms, each surrounded by a wide clear halo corresponding to the polysaccharide capsule
Yeast bodies are variably sized, often crescentic or shrunken and irregularly stained purple within the halo
Similar encapsulated yeast forms also present extracellularly among clumped red cells
60597.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage containing numerous intracellular yeast forms, each with a centrally or eccentrically placed, variably sized, crescent-shaped purple body surrounded by a thick, clear, non-staining halo; similar organisms are seen extracellularly. Distinct narrow-based budding is not clearly seen in this field. The wide capsular halos and size variability are characteristic, and findings are consistent with disseminated cryptococcosis involving the bone marrow; confirmation with mucicarmine or GMS staining, cryptococcal antigen and culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are smaller (2-4 um), uniform, with a thin artifactual clear halo and no thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Talaromyces divides by fission with a central transverse septum and lacks a wide capsule.
Candida shows budding yeasts with pseudohyphae and no capsular halo.
Leishmania have a nucleus and rod-shaped kinetoplast without a clear capsular halo.

60661.recognize_zh: A 圖胸部 CT 見前縱膈腔腫塊（箭頭）；B 圖細胞抹片中在大量小淋巴球背景中散布大型細胞，C 圖可見雙核、各有大而明顯嗜伊紅核仁的 Reed-Sternberg 細胞（貓頭鷹眼樣），支持結節硬化型古典何杰金淋巴瘤。
features: CT (A): anterior mediastinal soft-tissue mass (arrow), the typical site for nodular sclerosis cHL
Cytology (B): scattered large atypical cells singly and in small clusters in a background of numerous small lymphocytes and granulocytes
Classic binucleate Reed-Sternberg cell with mirror-image nuclei and large inclusion-like nucleoli (C)
Abundant pale to amphophilic cytoplasm in the large cells
Panel D: immunostain largely obscured by watermark; staining pattern cannot be reliably assessed
60661.describe_en: Contrast-enhanced chest CT (panel A) shows an anterior mediastinal mass. The cytologic preparation (panel B) shows scattered large atypical cells in a mixed background of small lymphocytes and granulocytes. At high power (panel C), a classic binucleate Reed-Sternberg cell with mirror-image nuclei and prominent, macronucleolus-like nucleoli is identified. The immunostain in panel D is largely obscured and cannot be interpreted from this image; confirmation requires CD30 and CD15 positivity with weak PAX5 and loss of CD45/CD20. Findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis subtype in this clinical setting, although fibrous bands and lacunar cells cannot be assessed on cytology.

ddx.vs: PMBL also forms an anterior mediastinal mass but consists of sheets of large B cells (CD20, CD79a strong) with clear cytoplasm and compartmentalizing sclerosis, lacking classic RS cells in a mixed background.
Gray zone lymphoma has sheets of pleomorphic RS-like cells with preserved strong CD20/B-cell program and CD30/CD15 co-expression, with a sparse inflammatory background.
ALCL shows cohesive sheets of hallmark cells with uniform strong CD30 and T-cell/cytotoxic markers, CD15 usually negative, and may be ALK positive.
These anterior mediastinal tumors show keratin-positive epithelial cells or germ cell markers (SALL4, OCT4) rather than CD30/CD15-positive RS cells.

60725.recognize_zh: 許多紅血球的血紅素偏向一側濃縮，另一側只剩透明膜狀泡（blister cell／半鬼影細胞，箭頭），並有咬痕狀缺口；插圖以超活體染色顯示附著於細胞膜的 Heinz 小體，提示氧化性溶血，本例為 rasburicase 誘發。
features: Numerous red cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side and a clear, membrane-bound blister-like zone at the opposite edge (blister cells/hemighosts, arrows)
Bite-like indentations and irregularly contracted, dense red cells
Scattered spherocyte-like dense cells, echinocytes and an occasional teardrop cell
Inset supravital stain: red cells with small dark peripheral membrane-attached inclusions consistent with Heinz bodies
Platelets present; no schistocytes or parasites seen
60725.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows many red cells in which hemoglobin is condensed toward one side, leaving a clear membrane-bound blister at the periphery, along with bite-like defects and dense irregularly contracted cells. Occasional echinocytes and a teardrop form are also seen; schistocytes are not identified. A supravital preparation (inset) demonstrates small refractile inclusions attached to the red cell membrane, consistent with Heinz bodies. Findings are consistent with oxidative (Heinz body) hemolytic anemia, here attributed to rasburicase; G6PD activity should be assessed once the acute hemolysis has settled, and methemoglobin measured.

ddx.dx: Hereditary spherocytosis / warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia
ddx.vs: Spherocytic anemias show round dense microspherocytes without eccentric hemoglobin or blisters, and AIHA is DAT positive.
MAHA shows schistocytes (helmet and triangle cells) with thrombocytopenia rather than blister cells and Heinz bodies.
Unstable hemoglobins also produce Heinz bodies but cause chronic lifelong hemolysis unrelated to drug exposure and are detected by isopropanol stability testing.
Artifactual clear areas are refractile and uniform across the field in thick areas, lacking the Heinz bodies seen on supravital staining.

60533.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 下淋巴結正常結構完全消失，藍色淋巴細胞背景中散佈大量融合成片、淡粉紅色的類上皮組織球小群，形成斑駁的粉藍交錯圖案；沒有成形的肉芽腫或壞死，這是 Lennert 淋巴瘤的低倍線索。
features: Low power: diffuse effacement of lymph node architecture without residual follicles
Mottled pattern of numerous small, confluent pale eosinophilic clusters of epithelioid histiocytes
Intervening dense small-to-medium lymphoid cells forming bluish cords and zones
No well-formed discrete granulomas or necrosis
Thin fibrous septum/capsule-like band with a cleft at the right lower field
60533.describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node shows diffuse effacement of the normal architecture with no residual follicles or sinuses identified. The node is replaced by a dense lymphoid infiltrate intimately admixed with numerous small, confluent clusters of pale eosinophilic epithelioid histiocytes, producing a mottled pink-and-blue pattern. No well-formed discrete granulomas or necrosis are seen. At this magnification cytologic atypia cannot be assessed, but the pattern is characteristic of lymphoepithelioid (Lennert) lymphoma, a variant of peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS, pending high-power review, immunophenotyping and TCR clonality.

ddx.vs: Toxoplasmosis preserves architecture with florid follicular hyperplasia, epithelioid clusters encroaching on follicles, and monocytoid B-cell sinus expansion.
These form discrete, well-circumscribed granulomas (sometimes necrotizing) rather than small confluent epithelioid clusters with diffuse effacement.
Mixed cellularity Hodgkin lymphoma may be epithelioid-rich but contains Reed-Sternberg cells and eosinophils in a polymorphous background.
THRLBCL has scattered large atypical CD20+ B cells within a histiocyte-rich background, identifiable at high power and by IHC.

60469.recognize_zh: CD20 染色下，成片的大型腫瘤細胞呈強烈、完整的膜性陽性，細胞核大而圓、泡狀，被纖細的間質分隔成巢狀；大細胞 B 細胞表型支持濾泡性淋巴瘤 3B 級（需配合結構判讀）。
features: Sheets and nests of large lymphoid cells with round vesicular nuclei
Strong, crisp circumferential membranous CD20 staining in nearly all tumor cells
Thin negative fibrovascular septa separating clusters
Few scattered negative spindle/stromal nuclei
Follicular versus diffuse architecture not assessable at this magnification
60469.describe_en: CD20 immunostain shows sheets of large neoplastic lymphoid cells with round vesicular nuclei and strong, uniform membranous positivity, separated by thin negative fibrovascular septa. The staining confirms a B-cell lineage of the large-cell population. The follicular architecture needed for the grade 3B designation cannot be assessed at this power and should be evaluated with CD21/CD23 for follicular dendritic cell meshworks. Findings support a large B-cell neoplasm consistent with follicular lymphoma, grade 3B, in the context of the corresponding H&E.

ddx.vs: DLBCL lacks CD21/CD23-positive follicular dendritic meshworks, and any diffuse area of large cells in FL 3B is reported as DLBCL.
Grade 3A follicles retain admixed centrocytes, whereas 3B follicles consist of solid sheets of centroblasts; this requires H&E assessment.

ddx.dx: Large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement
ddx.vs: It typically occurs in children/young adults in Waldeyer ring, is strongly MUM1/IRF4 positive, and shows IRF4 rearrangement.

60277.recognize_zh: 紅血球彼此邊緣重疊、串成2–3顆的短錢串狀排列（rouleaux），且即使在紅血球分散的薄片區仍可見；畫面中另有兩顆核偏位、細胞質深藍的漿細胞，提示與免疫球蛋白增加（骨髓瘤／漿細胞白血病）相關。
features: Red cells overlapping in short linear stacks of 2-3 cells ('stack of coins') in a thin area of the smear
Unstacked red cells are normocytic and normochromic with preserved central pallor
Circulating plasma cell (lower left) with eccentric round nucleus, clumped chromatin and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Second plasmacytoid cell (upper) with round nucleus and a rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Scattered small platelets; faint bluish background not clearly appreciable at this magnification
60277.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells aggregating into short linear stacks of two to three cells in an otherwise thin area, while isolated red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Two circulating plasmacytoid cells are present, including one with an eccentric nucleus, coarse chromatin and abundant basophilic cytoplasm. No red cell agglutinates (irregular clumps) are seen. Findings are consistent with rouleaux formation with circulating plasma cells, in keeping with plasma cell myeloma/plasma cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Agglutinates form irregular three-dimensional clumps rather than linear coin stacks and disperse on warming, whereas rouleaux disperse with saline dilution.
In thick smear areas overlap is random and nonlinear, whereas true rouleaux persist as linear stacks in the thin feathered edge.
Also causes rouleaux but circulating cells are mostly plasmacytoid lymphocytes with IgM paraprotein; separation requires immunofixation, flow cytometry and MYD88 L265P testing.

60149.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中細胞一片片排列，多為中大型母細胞：核卵圓或略不規則、染色質細緻、部分可見核仁，正常造血細胞明顯減少，符合急性白血病骨髓浸潤（本例為 MPAL）。
features: Sheets of intermediate-to-large blasts with loss of normal marrow architecture
Oval to irregular nuclei with fine, dispersed chromatin
Small but visible nucleoli in a subset of cells
Moderate pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Few residual small dark erythroid or lymphoid cells; overall cellularity not assessable at this magnification
60149.describe_en: High-power view of the H&E-stained bone marrow biopsy shows sheets of intermediate to large blasts with oval to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm. Residual normal hematopoietic elements are sparse. Overall cellularity cannot be judged at this magnification. The findings indicate extensive marrow involvement by acute leukemia, and lineage assignment as mixed phenotype acute leukemia requires flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable, and immunophenotyping must show absence of a second lineage.
Lymphoblasts are TdT-positive with CD19/PAX5 or CD3 without MPO, which requires IHC or flow.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Non-hematopoietic tumors form cohesive nests, are CD45 negative and express markers such as synaptophysin, desmin or keratin.
DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and CD20/PAX5 positivity, lacking CD34 and TdT.

60085.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中倍下細胞密度明顯增加、脂肪很少，由密集的未成熟細胞成片分布，其間散布許多粉紅色、體積偏小的巨核細胞；細胞密度高加上小型巨核細胞增多，提示需高倍確認 inv(3) AML 的低分葉巨核細胞。
features: Hypercellular marrow with markedly reduced fat
Diffuse sheets of immature mononuclear cells with dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Scattered, relatively small megakaryocytes with pink cytoplasm distributed throughout the field
Sinusoids with red cells; few residual maturing elements
Nuclear lobation of megakaryocytes not resolvable at this magnification
60085.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine core biopsy at lower power is hypercellular with markedly reduced fat and diffuse sheets of immature mononuclear cells. Scattered megakaryocytes throughout the field appear relatively small with eosinophilic cytoplasm, although nuclear lobation cannot be fully assessed at this magnification. Residual maturing hematopoietic elements are sparse. With the high-power findings of hypolobated megakaryocytes and inv(3)(q21q26.2), findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with inv(3)/MECOM rearrangement.

ddx.vs: APMF shows trilineage hyperplasia with dysplastic megakaryocytes and significant reticulin fibrosis, requiring reticulin stain and cytogenetics to separate.
PMF megakaryocytes are large, atypical and tightly clustered with cloud-like nuclei, not small, and blasts are not in sheets.
Lymphoma lacks megakaryocytic dysplasia and shows lineage-specific immunostaining (CD20, CD3).

60021.recognize_zh: CD45 免疫染色下，瀰漫成片的中型腫瘤細胞呈細顆粒狀的細胞膜染色，而右側鱗狀上皮完全不染，證明浸潤細胞屬造血來源而非上皮癌；需再加 MPO、CD33、lysozyme 等確認為骨髓肉瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-sized, monotonous tumor cells in the dermis
Weak to moderate, finely granular membranous CD45 staining in the majority of tumor cells
Round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin on hematoxylin counterstain
Adjacent squamous epithelium (right) is CD45 negative, serving as internal negative control
Rare strongly CD45-positive cell, likely a reactive small lymphocyte
60021.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD45 on the skin biopsy shows diffuse sheets of medium-sized tumor cells with weak to moderate, finely granular membranous staining, while the adjacent squamous epithelium is negative. The staining establishes hematolymphoid origin of the infiltrate and argues against carcinoma or melanoma. CD45 alone does not assign lineage; together with the reported positivity for CD33, CD4, lysozyme, and myeloperoxidase and negative cytokeratin, the findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma or other lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphomas are also CD45 positive but express CD20/PAX5 or T-cell markers and are MPO and lysozyme negative.
BPDCN commonly involves skin and expresses CD4 but is CD123, TCF4, and CD56 positive and MPO/lysozyme negative.
Carcinoma is cytokeratin positive and CD45 negative, unlike this infiltrate.
Merkel cell carcinoma is CK20 dot-positive and neuroendocrine marker positive and CD45 negative.

23605.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中同時可見帶粗大紫紅色嗜苯胺藍顆粒的異常前骨髓球（abnormal promyelocytes）與偏心核、嗜鹼性細胞質的漿細胞（箭頭處），右側核型圖在第 15、17 號染色體有箭頭標示 t(15;17) 並缺 Y 染色體。
features: Numerous abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse red-purple azurophilic granules
Admixed plasma cells (arrows) with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm
Nuclei of promyelocytes partly obscured by granules; Auer rods not discernible at this resolution
Cellular aspirate with fat droplets in the background
Karyotype panel: arrows at chromosomes 15 and 17 (t(15;17)(q24;q21)) and at the absent Y chromosome
23605.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (panel A) shows a cellular specimen containing two distinct abnormal populations: numerous promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm and dense, coarse azurophilic granulation, and scattered plasma cells (arrows) with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm. Auer rod bundles cannot be assessed at this magnification. The accompanying G-banded karyotype (panel B) shows a balanced t(15;17) and loss of the Y chromosome. Findings are consistent with concurrent acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML::RARA and a plasma cell neoplasm; plasma cell burden and clonality require quantitation and flow cytometry/immunohistochemistry.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocyte left shift (e.g., G-CSF, marrow recovery)
ddx.vs: Reactive promyelocytes have a visible paranuclear Golgi hof and orderly maturation to myelocytes, and lack t(15;17)/PML::RARA.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic by light-chain staining and usually form a minor population, whereas myeloma shows monotypic plasma cells with an M-protein.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation with prominent granulation
ddx.vs: Blasts predominate with a less uniform granular population and no t(15;17); cup-like or bilobed hypergranular promyelocytes favor APL.
Variant APL has bilobed nuclei with sparse fine granules, unlike the heavily granulated promyelocytes seen here.

19125.recognize_zh: 左圖顳骨電腦斷層可見中耳／乳突區軟組織密度影（箭頭），右圖外耳道皮膚低倍 H&E 在鱗狀上皮下與上皮內可見成團的藍色細胞浸潤（箭頭）；在 APL 移植後病史下，應想到髓外復發的骨髓肉瘤（myeloid sarcoma）。
features: Axial CT of the temporal bone with soft-tissue density opacifying the middle ear/mastoid air cells (white arrow)
Low-power H&E of external ear skin with acanthotic squamous epithelium
Discrete nests/aggregates of basophilic mononuclear cells within dermis and epithelium (black arrows)
Adjacent areas of hemorrhage in the superficial stroma
Individual cell cytology (granules, Auer rods, nuclear contour) not resolvable at this magnification
19125.describe_en: Axial CT of the temporal bone demonstrates soft-tissue opacification of the middle ear and mastoid air cells. Biopsy of the external ear canal at low power shows squamous mucosa/skin with discrete aggregates of basophilic mononuclear cells infiltrating the stroma and epithelium, accompanied by hemorrhage. Cytologic detail is not resolvable at this magnification, so confirmation requires higher-power review and ancillary studies (MPO/CD33/CD117 immunohistochemistry and PML-RARA FISH or RT-PCR). In the setting of prior acute promyelocytic leukemia, the findings are consistent with extramedullary relapse as a myeloid sarcoma.

ddx.vs: Cholesteatoma shows keratin debris and squamous epithelium without sheets of atypical immature hematopoietic cells, and inflammation is polymorphous rather than monotonous.
Lymphoma is MPO and CD33 negative with B- or T-cell marker expression, whereas APL myeloid sarcoma expresses MPO/CD33 and carries PML-RARA.
Morphology cannot separate them at this power; the distinction rests on demonstrating PML-RARA by FISH or RT-PCR.

18933.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中巨噬細胞的細胞質塞滿大量 2–4 µm 的卵圓形小體，每個小體都有一個深紫色核與旁邊一個棒狀小點（kinetoplast），部分散在細胞外，即利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（Leishman-Donovan bodies）。
features: Macrophages packed with numerous small oval organisms (~2-4 um) in foamy pale cytoplasm
Each organism has a round purple nucleus and a separate small rod-shaped kinetoplast
Clusters of extracellular amastigotes released from ruptured macrophages
Background erythroid precursors, a myelocyte-like cell, and scattered red cells
No capsule or clear halo around organisms
18933.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered macrophages whose cytoplasm is distended by numerous small oval intracellular organisms, with additional extracellular clusters, presumably from ruptured histiocytes. At high power each organism measures approximately 2-4 um and contains a nucleus and a distinct rod-shaped kinetoplast, without a capsule or halo. Background hematopoietic elements include erythroid precursors and granulocytic cells. Findings are consistent with visceral leishmaniasis (Leishman-Donovan bodies).

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo around a crescentic nucleus and lack a kinetoplast, and they stain with GMS/PAS, whereas Leishmania amastigotes have a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a single nucleus and no kinetoplast.
T. marneffei yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and lack a kinetoplast.
Platelets are granular, irregular, and lack the organized nucleus-plus-kinetoplast structure of amastigotes.

18485.recognize_zh: 這是兩張 Kaplan-Meier 存活曲線圖（非形態學影像）：A 為 FCR 前處置後 OS 78%、PFS 72%，B 為 YFC 前處置後 OS 88%、PFS 74%，曲線在移植後早期下降後呈長期平台；圖內前處置為非清髓性異體移植方案，與標題所寫的自體移植不完全一致。
features: Two Kaplan-Meier plots of cumulative proportion surviving versus months post transplant
Panel A (FCR regimen): OS 78% and PFS 72% with follow-up to about 140 months
Panel B (YFC regimen): OS 88% and PFS 74% with follow-up to about 90 months
Early drop within the first year followed by a sustained plateau, with tick marks for censored patients
Small cohorts suggested by stepwise curves
18485.describe_en: This non-morphologic figure shows Kaplan-Meier estimates of overall and progression-free survival after transplantation for follicular lymphoma. Panel A shows outcomes after FCR (fludarabine, cyclophosphamide, rituximab) conditioning, with OS of 78% and PFS of 72% at long-term follow-up, and panel B shows outcomes after YFC (90Y-ibritumomab tiuxetan with fludarabine and cyclophosphamide), with OS of 88% and PFS of 74%. Both curves show early events followed by a durable plateau, supporting a curative graft-versus-lymphoma effect. Note that FCR and YFC are reduced-intensity allogeneic conditioning regimens, so the figure actually depicts nonmyeloablative allogeneic rather than autologous transplantation as stated in the title.

16885.recognize_zh: 中央中性球核分成約7葉以上（hypersegmented neutrophil），右側另一顆中性球也有多葉；背景紅血球偏大並有橢圓形巨紅血球（macro-ovalocytes）與不規則形紅血球，符合惡性貧血（pernicious anemia）等巨母細胞性貧血。
features: Central neutrophil with about seven or more discrete nuclear lobes (hypersegmentation)
Second neutrophil at right edge also shows multiple lobes
Mature clumped chromatin with thin interlobar strands; normal pale granular cytoplasm
Red cells are large with oval macrocytes (macro-ovalocytes) and mild poikilocytosis, including a crenated cell and irregular forms
Neutrophil diameter slightly larger than usual relative to RBCs
16885.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with marked nuclear hypersegmentation, containing approximately seven or more lobes connected by thin chromatin strands, and a second multilobated neutrophil at the edge of the field. The red cells are predominantly macrocytic with oval macrocytes and mild poikilocytosis. Hypersegmented neutrophils (six or more lobes, or more than 5% with five lobes) together with macro-ovalocytes indicate impaired DNA synthesis. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia, as seen in pernicious anemia due to vitamin B12 deficiency.

ddx.vs: Folate deficiency produces identical smear findings; separation requires serum B12, folate, methylmalonic acid and homocysteine levels.
Morphology is indistinguishable, and medication history with normal vitamin levels identifies drug effect.
MDS shows dysplastic neutrophils that are more often hypogranular and hyposegmented (pseudo-Pelger) with normal B12/folate, rather than classic hypersegmentation.

ddx.dx: Hereditary neutrophil hypersegmentation / renal failure or iron deficiency
ddx.vs: These cause only mild hypersegmentation without macro-ovalocytes or megaloblastic marrow change.

15797.recognize_zh: 腦部 MRI 顯示右額葉大型病灶，T1 呈低訊號、DWI 呈高訊號（擴散受限）、T2 與皮質等訊號並伴周邊水腫，注射顯影劑後明顯增強並造成中線偏移，這種細胞密度高、擴散受限的腫塊符合原發性中樞神經淋巴瘤（PCNSL）。
features: Panel A (non-contrast T1): expansile hypointense right frontal mass (arrows) compressing the frontal horn of the lateral ventricle
Panel B (DWI): hyperintense signal within the lesion indicating restricted diffusion, reflecting high cellularity
Panel C (T2): lesion roughly isointense to cortex with surrounding hyperintense vasogenic edema and mass effect
Panel D (post-contrast T1): avid, largely peripheral/heterogeneous enhancement with a periventricular component (arrows)
Deep periventricular location with subfalcine midline shift
15797.describe_en: Axial brain MRI shows an expansile right frontal lobe mass that is hypointense on non-contrast T1-weighted imaging, isointense to cortex on T2-weighted imaging with surrounding vasogenic edema, and hyperintense on diffusion-weighted imaging with reduced apparent diffusion coefficient. After gadolinium, the lesion enhances avidly with a periventricular component and causes mass effect on the lateral ventricle with midline shift. This is a radiologic, not morphologic, image; restricted diffusion and T2 isointensity reflect a highly cellular tumor with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio. Findings are suggestive of primary CNS lymphoma, requiring stereotactic biopsy (ideally before corticosteroids) and CSF cytology/flow cytometry for confirmation.

ddx.vs: GBM typically shows thick irregular rim enhancement around central necrosis with T2 hyperintensity and less uniform diffusion restriction, often crossing the corpus callosum in a butterfly pattern.
Metastases are often multiple at the gray-white junction with disproportionate edema and a known primary, and usually lack marked diffusion restriction.
Abscesses show a smooth thin enhancing rim with central (not solid) diffusion restriction and a T2-hypointense capsule.
Tumefactive MS shows incomplete (open-ring) enhancement with peripheral diffusion restriction and less mass effect than expected for size.

13493.recognize_zh: 中倍關節液抹片以嗜中性球為主，中央的蛋白性物質中嵌有許多細長針狀結晶，右下可見吞噬細胞碎片的巨噬細胞；嗜中性球發炎液中出現大量針狀結晶，符合痛風關節液，需偏光顯微鏡確認負雙折射。
features: Neutrophil-predominant cellular fluid with segmented neutrophils throughout
Numerous slender needle-shaped crystals embedded in a pink-purple proteinaceous matrix in the center
Crystals predominantly extracellular in this field; intracellular crystals not clearly resolved
Macrophages with foamy cytoplasm, one containing phagocytosed nuclear debris (lower right)
Scattered red cells and vacuolated debris
13493.describe_en: Wright-stained synovial fluid smear shows a neutrophil-predominant inflammatory exudate. Within a central proteinaceous matrix are numerous slender needle-shaped crystals, mainly extracellular in this field. Foamy macrophages, including one with phagocytosed nuclear debris, and scattered red cells are also present. No organisms are identified. Findings are consistent with monosodium urate crystal-induced (gouty) arthritis; confirmation by polarized light microscopy for strongly negatively birefringent crystals and synovial fluid culture to exclude coexisting infection are recommended.

ddx.vs: CPPD crystals are short rhomboid rods with weak positive birefringence rather than long thin needles with strong negative birefringence.
Septic fluid shows organisms on Gram stain or culture and very high neutrophil counts, and crystals do not exclude concurrent infection.
Fibrin forms wavy, branching, non-refractile strands without the rigid straight edges and birefringence of urate crystals.

3317.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的骨髓被多形性大細胞取代，細胞核深染、形狀不規則且部分呈梭形，排列於纖維化基質中呈肉瘤樣外觀，並可見核分裂與少數嗜酸性球；此類 ALCL 侵犯容易被誤認為肉瘤或轉移癌。
features: Marrow space adjacent to a bony trabecula (lower left) replaced by a pleomorphic infiltrate
Large atypical cells with irregular, hyperchromatic, some spindled or elongated nuclei
Moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm; occasional cells with vesicular nuclei and nucleoli
Background fibrosis with streaming, sarcomatoid-like arrangement
Scattered mitotic figures and occasional eosinophils; normal hematopoiesis absent in this field
3317.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows the intertrabecular space replaced by a pleomorphic infiltrate of large atypical cells with irregular, hyperchromatic, partly spindled nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, set in a fibrotic stroma with a streaming, sarcomatoid pattern. Mitotic figures and scattered eosinophils are present, and normal hematopoietic elements are not seen in this field. Hallmark cells are not unequivocally identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma with associated fibrosis, but immunohistochemistry (CD30, ALK, CD45, keratin) is essential to exclude sarcoma or metastatic carcinoma.

ddx.vs: It shows cytokeratin positivity and is negative for CD30, ALK and CD45.

ddx.dx: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma or other sarcoma
ddx.vs: Sarcomas express mesenchymal markers and lack CD30, ALK, CD45 and T-cell antigens.
Hodgkin cells are scattered in a mixed inflammatory background and are CD15+ and ALK negative.
Myelofibrosis contains clustered atypical megakaryocytes and residual hematopoiesis rather than sheets of atypical CD30-positive cells.

2997.recognize_zh: 大型細胞內含粗大黑色色素顆粒，並可見明顯網狀染色質的大核；旁邊還有一顆幾乎全黑的色素細胞與背景散在的細小黑色顆粒，這種黑色素（melanin）沉積的非造血細胞提示轉移性黑色素瘤。
features: Large atypical cells with abundant cytoplasm containing coarse black-brown pigment granules
Large round to oval nucleus with open chromatin, partly obscured by pigment
Adjacent cell completely filled with dense black pigment
Fine dark pigment granules scattered in the background among red cells
Cells much larger than neighboring hematopoietic cells
2997.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered large non-hematopoietic cells with abundant cytoplasm containing coarse black-brown pigment granules that partly obscure large nuclei with open chromatin. A nearby cell is entirely filled with dense black pigment, and fine pigment granules are dispersed in the background. Findings are suggestive of metastatic melanoma with melanin production; immunohistochemistry for SOX10, S100, HMB-45 or Melan-A, and Prussian blue to exclude hemosiderin, are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin appears blue-green to golden and is Prussian blue positive, while melanin is black-brown and Prussian blue negative.
Mast cells have uniform, round, purple-black metachromatic granules and a central oval nucleus, and are tryptase/CD117 positive.
Melanophages have bland histiocytic nuclei and lack melanocytic marker expression, whereas melanoma cells show atypical nuclei and SOX10 positivity.
Carcinomas form cohesive clusters without melanin pigment and are cytokeratin positive.

2613.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片下方有一群聚集成片的上皮樣組織球（epithelioid histiocytes），核呈卵圓至拉長形、染色質細緻，細胞質豐富淡藍且邊界不清，混在正常造血細胞中，代表肉芽腫碎片，符合類肉瘤病（sarcoidosis）。
features: Aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes at the bottom of the field
Oval to elongated, slipper-shaped nuclei with fine, pale chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders forming a syncytial sheet
Background of normal trilineage hematopoiesis including neutrophils, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
No organisms or necrotic debris identified
2613.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with oval to elongated nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant pale blue syncytial cytoplasm, representing a granuloma fragment. The surrounding marrow contains maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes without an atypical population. No necrosis or microorganisms are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with granulomatous marrow involvement, compatible with sarcoidosis after exclusion of infection.

ddx.vs: Infectious granulomas more often show caseous necrosis and organisms on AFB/GMS stains and culture; sarcoidosis is a diagnosis of exclusion.

Carcinoma cells have round pleomorphic nuclei with prominent nucleoli and cohesive cell borders and are cytokeratin-positive, whereas epithelioid histiocytes have bland elongated nuclei and are CD68-positive.
Lymphoma-associated granulomas are accompanied by Reed-Sternberg cells or atypical lymphocytes on biopsy and immunostains.
Morphology is similar; medication history (e.g., checkpoint inhibitors) is the discriminator.

2933.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中，散在的嗜中性球外圍多有淡紫色血小板環繞成小花環，而背景中游離血小板稀少，全片規律出現這種現象即為 EDTA 相關的血小板衛星現象。
features: Low-power field with evenly spread normocytic red cells
Scattered neutrophils, many rimmed by small rosettes of adherent platelets
Few free platelets in the intervening background
Occasional lymphocyte without platelet adherence
No free platelet clumps or schistocytes; detail limited at this power
2933.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows evenly distributed normocytic red cells with scattered leukocytes. Many neutrophils are rimmed by small rosettes of adherent platelets, whereas occasional lymphocytes lack platelet adherence and free platelets are sparse in the background. Free platelet clumps and schistocytes are not seen. Fine platelet and leukocyte morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent platelet satellitism causing pseudothrombocytopenia; recollection in sodium citrate is recommended.

ddx.vs: ITP shows genuinely decreased platelets without platelets ringing neutrophils.
Platelet clumps float free of leukocytes and are often concentrated at the feathered edge.
Microangiopathy shows schistocytes with true thrombocytopenia, which are absent here.

1269.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆中型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質豐富且呈淡藍色，核圓、染色質中等凝集，右側那顆可見明顯的單一核仁，細胞邊緣略不規則；這種核仁明顯又有豐富細胞質的組合提示毛細胞白血病變異型，但此圖毛狀突起不明顯。
features: Two medium-sized lymphoid cells, about twice the diameter of a red cell
Moderate N:C ratio with abundant pale-to-medium blue cytoplasm
Round, centrally to slightly eccentrically placed nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Distinct single nucleolus, most evident in the right-hand cell
Cytoplasmic borders mildly irregular; well-formed hairy projections not evident
Background of normochromic red cells, some with central pallor artifact, and scattered platelets
1269.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have abundant pale blue cytoplasm with mildly irregular margins, round nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and a distinct single nucleolus, best seen in the right-hand cell. Well-developed hairy cytoplasmic projections are not appreciated in this field. Red cells and platelets show no specific abnormality. Findings are compatible with hairy cell leukemia variant in the appropriate context; confirmation requires flow cytometry (CD11c+, CD103+, CD25-negative) and absence of BRAF V600E.

ddx.vs: Classic hairy cells have bean-shaped nuclei with homogeneous chromatin, no prominent nucleolus and circumferential hairy projections, and are CD25+/BRAF V600E-positive.
Prolymphocytes also have a prominent nucleolus but typically less cytoplasm with smooth borders and very high counts without villous features.
SMZL cells are smaller with clumped chromatin, scant cytoplasm and polar villi, and lack a prominent nucleolus and CD103.
Reactive lymphocytes are part of a polymorphous population with deeply basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells and are polyclonal.

1205.recognize_zh: 組織切片中數條血管的管壁被大量淡粉紅色、均質無結構（amorphous）的物質增厚，並將管腔擠窄，細胞極少，是類澱粉沉積於血管壁（vascular amyloid）的典型表現；需以 Congo red 偏光確認。
features: Several small to medium vessels with markedly thickened walls
Walls replaced by pale, homogeneous, amorphous eosinophilic material with few nuclei
Narrowed or compressed vascular lumina, one containing red cells
Surrounding loose fibrous connective tissue with similar pale deposits
Minimal inflammatory infiltrate; adjacent bone/hematopoietic tissue at the edges
1205.describe_en: Section of connective tissue adjacent to marrow shows several vessels with walls markedly thickened by pale, homogeneous, amorphous eosinophilic material that narrows the lumina. The deposits are acellular and extend focally into the surrounding stroma, with no significant inflammation. This appearance is characteristic of amyloid deposition, which should be confirmed by Congo red staining with apple-green birefringence and typed (e.g., mass spectrometry). Findings are consistent with vascular amyloidosis, as seen in AL amyloidosis associated with a plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Hyaline arteriolosclerosis involves arterioles with glassy, more intensely eosinophilic PAS-positive deposits that are Congo red-negative.
LCDD deposits are non-fibrillar, Congo red-negative and show linear light-chain staining on immunofluorescence.
Collagen is fibrillary and more brightly eosinophilic with trichrome positivity, and lacks Congo red birefringence.

1141.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血組織被一片片細胞質豐富、呈粉紅顆粒狀、核為卵圓或摺疊形的單一形態細胞取代，其間夾雜大量紅血球，正常三系造血難以辨認，提示急性前骨髓細胞性白血病（APL）浸潤。
features: Hypercellular marrow with sheets of monotonous cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
Moderately abundant, eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm
Oval, indented or folded nuclei with fine chromatin; some nucleoli visible
Numerous extravasated red cells interspersed among the tumor cells
Adjacent bony trabecula and scattered fat spaces
1141.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular and shows diffuse sheets of monotonous immature myeloid cells with moderately abundant, eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and oval to folded nuclei with fine chromatin. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is effaced, and there are numerous interspersed red cells. Megakaryocytes are not evident in this field. The findings are consistent with involvement by acute leukemia with promyelocytic features; given the risk of coagulopathy, urgent confirmation of PML::RARA by FISH or RT-PCR is recommended.

ddx.dx: Other acute myeloid leukemia (with maturation or myelomonocytic)
ddx.vs: Morphology on core biopsy overlaps; APL is confirmed by aspirate showing hypergranular promyelocytes with faggot cells, a CD34-/HLA-DR- phenotype, and PML::RARA.

ddx.dx: Marked promyelocyte hyperplasia (recovering marrow, G-CSF effect)
ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows a synchronized wave of normal promyelocytes that mature with time, lacks PML::RARA, and retains megakaryocytes and erythroid islands.
Myeloma cells have eccentric round nuclei with clock-face chromatin and perinuclear hofs, and are CD138 positive and MPO negative.

1077.recognize_zh: 箭頭指向一顆大型漿細胞，核偏位且小、有核周淡染區，細胞質非常豐富呈藍紫色；典型火焰細胞（flame cell）應有邊緣紅紫色的細胞質，此圖紅色邊緣不明顯，僅部分符合。
features: Large plasma cell (arrow) with voluminous blue-violet cytoplasm, several times the nuclear area
Small eccentric round nucleus with coarse chromatin and adjacent perinuclear hof
Cytoplasm with slightly mottled texture; a distinct magenta/red peripheral fringe is not evident
Background of maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors, lymphocytes, and red cells
1077.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large plasma cell (arrow) with a small eccentric nucleus, perinuclear hof, and voluminous blue-violet cytoplasm. The cytoplasm appears slightly mottled but lacks a clearly defined red-purple peripheral fringe typical of classic flame cells. Background maturing myeloid and erythroid cells and small lymphocytes are present. Findings represent a plasma cell with abundant cytoplasm raising the possibility of a flame cell, which is associated with IgA-secreting plasma cell neoplasms but is not specific.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts are larger, occur in clusters, and have an eccentric nucleus with a hof located away from, not adjacent to, the nucleus and lack immunoglobulin.
Mott cells contain discrete Russell body globules, whereas flame cells have diffuse cytoplasm with a magenta periphery due to glycoprotein-rich immunoglobulin.
Macrophages have a central or kidney-shaped nucleus without a hof and vacuolated cytoplasm with phagocytosed debris.

4213.recognize_zh: 淋巴結正常結構被瀰漫性的中小型、核形不規則的淋巴球取代，其間穿插明顯的高內皮小靜脈（HEV），屬於成熟 T 細胞淋巴瘤的樣貌；ATLL 的確診仍需 HTLV-1 血清學與免疫表型。
features: Diffuse sheets of small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells
Irregular, angulated and elongated hyperchromatic nuclei
Scattered larger cells with vesicular chromatin
Prominent branching high endothelial venules traversing the infiltrate
Admixed extravasated red cells; no follicles in this field
4213.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show effacement of normal architecture by a diffuse infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated hyperchromatic nuclei and occasional larger cells. Arborizing high endothelial venules are conspicuous. No residual follicles are seen in this field. The morphology is that of a mature T-cell lymphoma; in the appropriate clinical and serologic (HTLV-1) setting, findings are consistent with nodal involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: AITL shows a polymorphous background with expanded FDC meshworks, clear-cell clusters around HEVs and TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13), whereas ATLL is HTLV-1 positive and usually CD25+/FOXP3+.
PTCL-NOS can look identical on H&E and is separated only by negative HTLV-1 serology/proviral integration.
Reactive hyperplasia preserves follicles and sinuses and lacks the monotonous nuclear atypia and aberrant T-cell phenotype.

4149.recognize_zh: 中央是一個玻璃樣變（hyalinized）、內含血管與樹突細胞的萎縮生發中心，外圍小淋巴球呈同心圓「洋蔥皮」（onion-skin）排列，是透明血管型 Castleman 病的典型濾泡。
features: Regressed (atretic) germinal center with pink hyalinized stroma and eosinophilic material
Germinal center composed largely of plump, elongated follicular dendritic/endothelial cells with vesicular nuclei rather than centroblasts
Broad mantle zone of small mature lymphocytes arranged in concentric onion-skin rings
Small vessels penetrating/around the follicle; a second small follicle with similar concentric layering at upper right
Interfollicular area of small lymphocytes with scattered small vessels; no sheets of plasma cells
4149.describe_en: Lymph node section shows lymphoid follicles with regressed, hyalinized germinal centers composed predominantly of follicular dendritic cells and endothelial cells with pink hyaline stroma. The follicles are surrounded by expanded mantle zones in which small lymphocytes are arranged in concentric onion-skin layers. The interfollicular region contains small lymphocytes and small vessels without a prominent plasma cell infiltrate or atypical large cells. Findings are consistent with hyaline vascular (unicentric) Castleman disease.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell / multicentric Castleman disease (incl. HHV-8)
ddx.vs: Shows sheets of interfollicular plasma cells, often with hyperplastic rather than predominantly regressed follicles, and HHV-8 LANA-1 positive plasmablasts in the mantle in HHV-8 associated cases.

ddx.dx: Follicular dendritic cell sarcoma arising in Castleman disease
ddx.vs: Forms sheets and fascicles of atypical spindle dendritic cells effacing the architecture rather than confined dysplastic dendritic cells within follicles.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: The expanded mantle cells are monotonous, slightly irregular, and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, whereas the concentric mantle here is polyclonal and cyclin D1 negative.

ddx.dx: Reactive follicular hyperplasia with regressed follicles (e.g., HIV, autoimmune)
ddx.vs: Regressed follicles are usually admixed with hyperplastic germinal centers and lack the widespread onion-skinning with lollipop vessels.

3957.recognize_zh: 高倍血片中紅血球呈兩群：一群淡染、只剩細邊的低色素細胞，另一群是中央有血紅素點的標靶細胞（target cells），並夾雜淚滴狀碎片，符合地中海型貧血的紅血球變化。
features: Dimorphic red cell population: markedly hypochromic, thin-rimmed 'ghost-like' cells alongside better-hemoglobinized cells
Numerous target cells with a central dot of hemoglobin (bull's-eye appearance)
Red cells small relative to expected normocytes (microcytosis), with anisocytosis
Poikilocytes including a small teardrop-shaped fragment
Occasional platelet in background; no nucleated cells in this field
3957.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a dimorphic red cell population composed of markedly hypochromic microcytes with only a thin rim of hemoglobin and better-hemoglobinized cells, many of which are target cells. Anisopoikilocytosis is present, including a small teardrop-shaped fragment. No nucleated red cells or red cell inclusions are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with thalassemia; the dimorphic pattern may reflect prior transfusion.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows pencil cells and hypochromia with fewer target cells and a disproportionately low MCV-to-RBC count relationship, and iron studies are low rather than normal or high.
HbC produces abundant target cells but they are well hemoglobinized, often with rhomboid HbC crystals, and hemoglobin electrophoresis shows HbC.
Sideroblastic anemia also gives a dimorphic hypochromic population but shows Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts on marrow iron stain.
Liver disease target cells are normochromic and often macrocytic, without the hypochromic microcytic population.

3829.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，在高細胞量的造血組織間散布多個淡染、透亮帶泡沫感的區域與褐色色素聚集，代表成群的泡沫狀組織球（Niemann-Pick 細胞）；此倍率細節有限，需高倍或抹片確認。
features: Cellular marrow with trabecular bone and preserved trilineage hematopoiesis
Scattered pale, clear to finely vacuolated foci consistent with clusters of foamy histiocytes
Focal aggregates of brown granular pigment (ceroid/hemosiderin-laden histiocytes)
No discrete tumor infiltrate or fibrosis evident
Low magnification limits confirmation of cytoplasmic foam at the single-cell level
3829.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a cellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis between bony trabeculae. Scattered pale, clear to finely vacuolated foci consistent with clusters of foamy histiocytes are present, along with focal aggregates of brown granular pigment. Individual cell detail is limited at this magnification. In the clinical context, findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a lipid storage disorder such as Niemann-Pick disease; higher-power examination and aspirate smears are needed to characterize the storage cells.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than bubbly foamy cytoplasm and are PAS strongly positive.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells/sea-blue histiocytes in high-turnover states (e.g., CML)
ddx.vs: Secondary storage cells occur with an underlying myeloid neoplasm showing myeloid hyperplasia and BCR::ABL1, not in isolation.
Infected foamy histiocytes in immunosuppressed patients contain AFB-positive bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Lipogranulomas are few, small, and centered on fat droplets rather than diffuse clusters of storage cells.

3573.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的顆粒球細胞核中央有一個洞，形成甜甜圈狀的環形核（ring/doughnut nucleus），細胞質淡藍、顆粒稀少；周圍數顆骨髓細胞與後骨髓細胞也顆粒偏少。環形核與顆粒減少都是顆粒球生成異常（dysgranulopoiesis）的表現。
features: Granulocytic precursor with a ring-shaped (doughnut) nucleus containing a central clear hole (arrow)
Pale blue, hypogranular cytoplasm in the ring-nucleus cell and several neighboring myelocytes/metamyelocytes
Other myeloid precursors with kidney-shaped or indented nuclei and clumped chromatin
A promyelocyte-like cell with prominent azurophilic granules and a large, folded monocytoid cell present
Erythroid precursor with deep blue cytoplasm; background RBCs with drying artifact
3573.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic precursors with dysplastic features. A metamyelocyte/band-stage cell contains a ring-shaped nucleus with a central cytoplasmic hole (arrow), and it and several neighboring myelocytes have pale, hypogranular cytoplasm. A granular promyelocyte, an erythroid precursor and a larger cell with folded nucleus are also present. Findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis; quantification (at least 10% dysplastic cells) and exclusion of reactive causes such as drugs, alcohol or copper deficiency are required before attributing this to a myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Pelger-type cells show hyposegmented bilobed or round nuclei with coarse chromatin, not a nucleus with a central hole.
Occasional ring forms occur in reactive states; the distinction relies on the frequency of dysplasia, multilineage involvement and clinical context.
Megaloblastic change produces giant metamyelocytes with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, often with megaloblastic erythroids and low B12/folate.

3637.recognize_zh: 一顆比紅血球稍大的淋巴球，細胞核有明顯的摺疊與溝紋、輪廓不規則，染色質濃密，周圍只剩一圈薄薄淡藍色細胞質；這種核摺皺的淋巴球符合 Sézary 細胞。背景紅血球皺縮為乾燥假象。
features: Medium-sized lymphocyte with high N:C ratio
Irregular, folded nucleus with grooves and overlapping lobes (convoluted contour)
Dense, hyperchromatic chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Background crenated RBCs, consistent with drying artifact
3637.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single medium-sized atypical lymphocyte with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, a folded and grooved nuclear contour, dense chromatin and no prominent nucleolus. The cytoplasm forms a thin pale blue agranular rim. Background red cells are crenated, most likely artifactual. The nuclear convolutions are less finely cerebriform than in classic examples at this resolution. Findings are consistent with a Sézary cell; diagnosis requires an adequate count of such cells with supportive flow cytometry and T-cell clonality.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells have multilobated petal-like nuclei with distinct lobes, and patients are HTLV-1 seropositive.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma or other B-cell lymphoma with nuclear clefts
ddx.vs: Cleaved B cells have a single notch or cleft rather than multiple grooves, and flow cytometry shows a clonal B-cell population.
Normal small lymphocytes have a smooth round or slightly indented contour without multiple folds.

3445.recognize_zh: 中央一顆白血球（偏單核球/組織球樣，核不規則）細胞質內有數個含紫色小顆粒的空泡，形狀大小與旁邊的游離血小板相同，代表吞噬了血小板。
features: Single leukocyte with irregular, folded nucleus and gray-violet granular cytoplasm
Several cytoplasmic vacuoles, at least two containing small purple bodies the size of platelets
Free platelets nearby are of similar size and staining to the ingested bodies
Background red cells normocytic, normochromic with central pallor
Platelets overall appear sparse in the field
3445.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells and sparse platelets. A leukocyte with an irregular folded nucleus contains several clear phagocytic vacuoles, some of which enclose small purple bodies morphologically identical to adjacent free platelets. Findings are consistent with leukocyte phagocytosis of platelets, which may be seen in immune-mediated thrombocytopenia, sepsis, or as an in vitro EDTA-related phenomenon.

ddx.vs: In satellitism platelets adhere around the outer rim of neutrophils rather than lying within cytoplasmic vacuoles.
Histoplasma yeasts have a clear halo with a crescentic nucleus and Anaplasma morulae are stippled clusters, unlike granular platelet fragments.
An LE cell contains a large homogeneous purple nuclear mass displacing the nucleus rather than small granular platelets.

3253.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中到處是細胞質充滿鮮亮橘紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球及其前驅細胞，很多呈雙葉核，數量明顯超過其他造血細胞；左側可見一顆多葉核的巨核細胞，代表嗜酸性球增多。
features: Hypercellular marrow with markedly increased eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors
Bright orange-red coarsely granular cytoplasm; many bilobed nuclei and round-nucleated myelocytes
Megakaryocyte with lobulated nucleus at left
