Scattered erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei and neutrophil lineage cells
Fat spaces at corners; no sheets of blasts or mast cell aggregates in this field
3253.describe_en: Bone marrow section (H&E) shows a hypercellular marrow with a marked increase in eosinophils and their precursors, recognized by bright orange-red coarsely granular cytoplasm and bilobed or round nuclei. Megakaryocytes, erythroid precursors and neutrophilic cells are present in reduced proportion. No sheets of blasts or compact spindled mast cell aggregates are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow eosinophilia; clinical correlation, tryptase level, and cytogenetic/molecular testing are recommended to exclude a clonal eosinophilic neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical in many cases; defined by PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, JAK2 or FLT3 rearrangements.
Mastocytosis shows compact aggregates of spindled mast cells with clear cytoplasm, highlighted by tryptase/CD117/CD25.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows eosinophils within a polymorphous infiltrate containing large CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells and fibrosis.
Neutrophilic precursors have pale pink fine granules rather than coarse bright orange-red granules on H&E.

3125.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現數顆典型漿細胞：核偏位、染色質塊狀、豐富深藍色胞質並有核周淡染區（hof），背景紅血球呈錢串狀，提示漿細胞白血病。
features: Several mature-appearing plasma cells with abundant deep blue cytoplasm
Round eccentric nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin
Distinct pale perinuclear hof
Smaller plasmacytoid cell at left with eccentric nucleus and less cytoplasm
Red cells stacked in rouleaux in the background
3125.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several circulating plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and a well-defined perinuclear hof. A smaller plasmacytoid cell is also present. The red cells show rouleaux formation. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia if circulating plasma cells reach at least 5% of leukocytes.

ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells are sparse and polytypic, typically with infection or serum sickness, and no monoclonal protein.
LPL is dominated by small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with CD19/CD20-positive B cells and MYD88 L265P.
Reactive lymphocytes have central nuclei with cytoplasm hugging adjacent red cells and lack a crisp perinuclear hof.

3061.recognize_zh: 酸洗脫染色高倍下，每一個紅血球都保留程度不一的粉紅色，沒有完全透明的鬼影細胞，顯示 HbF 為全細胞（pancellular）分布，符合 HbS/HPFH。
features: Well-spread monolayer of red cells on acid-elution (Kleihauer-Betke) stain
Every red cell retains pink staining, ranging from moderate to intense
No completely eluted, empty ghost cells identified
Some cells show a mottled or reticulated internal staining pattern
Pattern consistent with pancellular HbF distribution
3061.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood film stained by the acid-elution (Kleihauer-Betke) technique. All red cells in the field retain eosin staining, with some variation in intensity and a mottled internal pattern in a subset of cells, but no fully eluted ghost cells are present. This pancellular distribution of acid-resistant fetal hemoglobin is consistent with hereditary persistence of fetal hemoglobin, here coinherited with hemoglobin S.

ddx.dx: HbS-beta0 thalassemia or HbSS with high HbF on hydroxyurea
ddx.vs: These show heterocellular staining, with distinct F-cells next to clear ghost cells, rather than retention of stain by every cell.
HbF is heterocellular and red cells are microcytic, whereas deletional HPFH gives pancellular staining; globin gene analysis is definitive.
Only a small fraction of cells stain darkly against a background of maternal ghost cells.

2805.recognize_zh: 周邊血中三顆大型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻均勻，細胞質少量淡藍，未見 Auer 小體；單看這張只能認出是急性白血病母細胞，單核球分化須靠 NSE 或流式細胞儀佐證。
features: Three large blasts, 2-3 times the diameter of red cells
Round to slightly oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
Nucleoli indistinct at this magnification
Scant to moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm without visible granules or Auer rods
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking; no mature leukocytes in field
2805.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large blasts with high N:C ratios, round to slightly oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and a thin rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm. Cytoplasmic granules and Auer rods are not seen, and definite monocytic features such as nuclear folding or gray vacuolated cytoplasm are not evident in these cells. The morphology indicates circulating blasts; separation of myeloblasts and monoblasts/promonocytes requires cytochemistry (MPO, NSE) and flow cytometry. These findings are compatible with, but not specific for, acute myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts may look identical; MPO negativity and TdT/CD19 or CD3 expression by flow cytometry identify ALL.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation or without maturation
ddx.vs: These lack a monocytic component (NSE-negative, CD14/CD64 low), whereas AMMoL requires >=20% monocytic cells and >=20% neutrophil lineage cells.
Monoblastic leukemia shows >=80% monocytic cells with abundant gray cytoplasm and folded nuclei and few neutrophil-lineage cells.

ddx.dx: Large cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells tend to have coarser chromatin, nuclear irregularity and deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, and express mature B- or T-cell markers.

2741.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多顆中型淋巴細胞，核型不規則、有凹陷或腎形，細胞質少且偏嗜鹼性，邊緣有明顯的細胞質小突起（blebs）；這種不規則核加上細胞質突起是 T-PLL 的典型外觀。
features: Increased intermediate-sized lymphoid cells scattered among red cells
High N:C ratio with scant basophilic cytoplasm
Prominent cytoplasmic blebs/protrusions at the cell margins
Irregular, indented to reniform nuclear contours
Moderately condensed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
2741.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increased number of intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, irregular indented or reniform nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm with conspicuous surface blebs. Red cells appear normochromic without significant poikilocytosis. The cytoplasmic protrusions and nuclear irregularity are characteristic of T-prolymphocytes. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; confirm with flow cytometry (CD2, CD3, CD5, strong CD7; CD4+ or CD4/CD8 co-expression) and TCL1A/MTCP1 studies.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have finely grooved cerebriform nuclei and are usually CD7-negative, with associated erythroderma.
ATLL cells show multilobated flower-shaped nuclei, CD25 positivity and HTLV-1 infection.
Hairy cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with circumferential fine projections and oval nuclei with spongy chromatin, and express CD103/CD11c/CD25 B-cell markers.
Leukemic MCL cells may be cleaved but lack blebs and are cyclin D1-positive B cells.

2677.recognize_zh: 細胞質塞滿大小一致、圓形粗大的顆粒，顆粒間可見雙葉核的輪廓；均勻的圓形大顆粒加上雙葉核就是嗜酸性球。本張染色偏暗，顆粒呈紫紅褐色而非典型橘紅色。
features: Granulocyte slightly larger than a neutrophil
Bilobed nucleus partly obscured by overlying granules
Cytoplasm packed with uniform, round, coarse granules
Granules appear dark red-purple in this image, likely stain-related rather than the classic bright orange
Surrounding red cells with poikilocytes and a crenated cell
2677.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a granulocyte with a bilobed nucleus and cytoplasm completely filled with large, uniform, round granules. The granules stain darker red-purple than usual, likely reflecting staining conditions, but their uniform size and spherical shape, with a visible bilobed nucleus beneath, support eosinophilic granules. Adjacent red cells show mild poikilocytosis with an echinocyte. Findings are consistent with a mature eosinophil.

ddx.vs: Basophil granules are irregular in size, deep purple-black and obscure the nucleus, rather than uniform round refractile granules.
Toxic granules are fine, dark and scattered in pink cytoplasm with a multilobed nucleus clearly visible.

ddx.dx: Abnormal eosinophil of AML with inv(16)
ddx.vs: Inv(16) eosinophils are immature forms with large dark basophilic granules mixed with orange granules, found alongside increased blasts.

2485.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞量多，可見多個胞質灰藍、核摺疊的單核球與前單核球，混合各階段顆粒球前驅細胞與有核紅血球，原始細胞並未成片；這種骨髓單核球系增生而原始細胞未達 20% 的樣態符合 JMML。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with mixed myelomonocytic proliferation
Numerous monocytes and promonocytes with folded/indented nuclei, fine chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm
Granulocytic precursors at various stages, including promyelocytes with coarse granules and a hypogranular neutrophil
Scattered erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei
Blasts present but not forming sheets
2485.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and shows a mixed myelomonocytic proliferation. Monocytes and promonocytes with folded nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm are increased, admixed with granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation and scattered erythroid precursors. Occasional blasts are present but do not form sheets, and dysplastic changes are mild. Findings are consistent with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical and genetic context (blasts plus promonocytes <20%, BCR-ABL1 negative, RAS-pathway mutation).

ddx.vs: AML shows >=20% blasts plus promonocytes forming sheets, whereas JMML has a preserved maturing background.
CML marrow is dominated by myelocytes and neutrophils with basophilia and dwarf megakaryocytes and is BCR-ABL1 positive.
CMML has similar morphology but occurs in older adults and lacks the JMML diagnostic setting of childhood onset with RAS-pathway mutations.

2101.recognize_zh: 這是 HTLV-1 抗體西方墨點法（Western blot）圖，非形態學影像：移植前（0 個月）可見 rgp46、p36、p32、p28、p24、p19、p21E 多條強帶，骨髓移植後各帶逐漸變淡，僅 p19 與 rgp46 持續存在，反映抗病毒抗體下降。
features: HTLV-1 Western blot strips with positive (P) and negative (N) controls
Month 0 (pre-BMT) strip shows strong bands for env (rgp46, p21E) and gag (p19, p24, p28, p32, p36) proteins
Post-BMT strips (5, 7, 17, 26, 38 months) show progressive fading of gag bands, with loss of p24, p21E, and most p28-p36 bands
p19 and rgp46 bands persist through 38 months
Negative control shows no bands, confirming assay specificity
2101.describe_en: This figure is a Western blot for anti-HTLV-1 antibodies in serial sera from a patient with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma before and after allogeneic bone marrow transplantation. The pre-transplant (month 0) sample shows strong reactivity to env (rgp46, p21E) and multiple gag proteins (p19, p24, p28, p32, p36), exceeding the positive control. After transplantation, band intensity decreases progressively, with persistence mainly of p19 and rgp46 up to 38 months. The pattern indicates a decline of the anti-HTLV-1 antibody response after BMT, interpreted as reduction of HTLV-1-infected cell burden; this is serologic data and does not provide morphologic information.

2037.recognize_zh: 藍色復染（methylene blue）背景中，只有中間兩條細長、略彎的洋紅色桿菌，這是抗酸染色（acid-fast stain）陽性的分枝桿菌（mycobacteria）；菌量稀少，需在高倍下仔細搜尋。
features: Acid-fast stain with blue methylene blue counterstain
Rare slender, slightly curved magenta-red bacilli in the center of the field
Bacilli lie among plump epithelioid-type histiocyte nuclei
Paucibacillary: only two organisms visible in this high-power field
No background necrosis or other organisms identifiable at this resolution
2037.describe_en: Acid-fast (Ziehl-Neelsen-type) stained tissue section shows a cellular background of oval histiocyte nuclei with pale cytoplasm in blue counterstain. Rare slender, slightly curved magenta acid-fast bacilli are identified near the center of the field. Organisms are sparse. Findings are consistent with mycobacterial infection; culture or PCR is needed for speciation.

ddx.vs: Nocardia forms branching beaded filaments that are only weakly (modified) acid-fast, whereas mycobacteria are short, non-branching, strongly acid-fast rods.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterium avium complex in immunosuppressed host
ddx.vs: MAC typically shows sheets of histiocytes stuffed with innumerable bacilli, while M. tuberculosis granulomas are usually paucibacillary as here; speciation requires culture or PCR.
True bacilli have uniform slender rod shape with parallel sides and occasional beading, whereas precipitate is irregular, refractile and often out of the plane of focus.

1845.recognize_zh: 骨髓中滿是無顆粒的芽細胞，大小不一，較大的細胞有淡藍色細胞質與清楚的小核仁，較小的核染色較深、細胞質極少；左上角可見一個有絲分裂像，符合淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Blasts of variable size with scant to moderate pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei, some with slight irregularity or indentation
Fine chromatin with one to several small but visible nucleoli in larger blasts
Smaller blasts with denser chromatin and very high N:C ratio
Mitotic figure in the upper left; no Auer rods
1845.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows diffuse replacement by blasts with heterogeneous size. Larger blasts have moderate agranular pale blue cytoplasm, round nuclei, fine chromatin and small visible nucleoli, while smaller blasts have scant cytoplasm and denser chromatin. A mitotic figure is present, and no Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia, with B-lineage assignment dependent on flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts often show more prominent nucleoli, occasional azurophilic granules or Auer rods, and are MPO positive in at least 3% of blasts.
Morphologically indistinguishable; cytoplasmic CD3 by flow establishes T lineage.
Cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and are TdT-negative mature B cells with surface light chain.

1781.recognize_zh: 這顆嗜中性球的細胞質中散布多顆大小不一、不規則的深紫灰色巨大顆粒，體積遠大於一般的中性顆粒，背景細胞質則相對缺乏正常顆粒，這種巨大包涵顆粒是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的典型表現。
features: Mature neutrophil with bilobed/elongated segmented nucleus
Multiple giant, irregular, dark purple-grey cytoplasmic granules of varying size
Granules markedly larger than normal neutrophilic granules; background cytoplasm pale and relatively agranular
Normocytic, normochromic red cells
Normal-appearing platelets in the background
1781.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature segmented neutrophil containing multiple giant, irregular, dark purple-grey cytoplasmic granules that are several times the size of normal neutrophilic granules, set in otherwise pale cytoplasm. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic, and platelets appear unremarkable. Findings are characteristic of Chediak-Higashi abnormality (giant fused lysosomal granules due to LYST mutation); correlation with partial albinism, recurrent infections and the risk of an accelerated hemophagocytic phase is advised.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules in AML or MDS
ddx.vs: Giant granules arise from abnormal fusion in dysplastic or leukemic myeloid cells, in the setting of increased blasts and other dysplasia.
Consists of numerous fine, evenly distributed dark granules of uniform size rather than a few giant irregular granules.
Dense, uniformly sized purple granules are present in all leukocyte lineages and are associated with mucopolysaccharidoses.
Inclusions are pale blue, spindle-shaped peripheral cytoplasmic bodies, accompanied by giant platelets in MYH9 disorders.

1653.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆異常前骨髓細胞：右側細胞核呈雙葉（蝴蝶狀），細胞質有密集紫紅色顆粒；左側細胞質帶空泡，箭頭指一顆圓形紫紅色大型包涵體（異常大顆粒，類 Chédiak-Higashi 顆粒）。這些特徵是 APL 的線索。
features: Two large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm
Right cell with bilobed (butterfly-like) nucleus and dense purple azurophilic granules
Left cell with round nucleus, visible nucleoli and vacuolated cytoplasm
Arrow: round reddish-purple cytoplasmic inclusion consistent with a giant abnormal granule (pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi type)
Partial third cell with folded nucleus at lower left
Background red cells including an echinocyte
1653.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two large abnormal promyelocytes. One has a bilobed, butterfly-shaped nucleus and cytoplasm containing dense purple azurophilic granules, while the other has a round nucleus with nucleoli, vacuolated cytoplasm and a round reddish-purple cytoplasmic inclusion (arrow) consistent with a giant abnormal granule rather than a slender Auer rod. A partially visualized cell with a folded nucleus is present at the lower left. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia; this is a medical emergency, and urgent coagulation studies and PML::RARA confirmation (FISH/RT-PCR) with immediate ATRA are indicated.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have fewer granules, round nuclei and occasional single Auer rods, lacking bilobed hypergranular promyelocytes and PML::RARA.
Normal promyelocytes have round eccentric nuclei with a Golgi hof and appear with a full maturing myeloid spectrum, not bilobed nuclei or giant granules.
Monocytic blasts have folded nuclei with grey-blue, finely granular cytoplasm and are NSE-positive with weak MPO, unlike strongly MPO-positive hypergranular APL cells.
Inherited giant granules occur in mature neutrophils and lymphocytes with normal nuclear maturation, not in leukemic promyelocytes.

1525.recognize_zh: 這是染色體部分核型圖（非型態圖）：左側比對正常 14 號與 inv(14)(q11q32.1)，箭頭標出 q11 與 q32.1 斷裂點；右側比對正常 8 號與 i(8q) 等臂染色體，是 T-PLL 最具代表性的細胞遺傳異常組合。
features: Partial G-banded karyogram comparing normal chromosome 14 with inv(14)
Arrows mark breakpoints at 14q11 (TRA/TRD locus) and 14q32.1 (TCL1A locus)
Altered banding pattern of the inverted 14 long arm compared with the normal homolog
Normal chromosome 8 beside an isochromosome 8q with two identical long arms and loss of 8p
Blue horizontal line aligns centromeres for comparison
1525.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic cytogenetic figure showing selected G-banded chromosomes aligned at the centromere. The first pair compares a normal chromosome 14 with an inverted chromosome 14, with breakpoints marked at q11 and q32.1, corresponding to inv(14)(q11q32.1). The second pair compares a normal chromosome 8 with an isochromosome 8q, i(8q), which consists of two long arms and no short arm. inv(14)(q11q32.1) juxtaposes TCL1A with the T-cell receptor alpha/delta locus and, together with i(8q), is the characteristic cytogenetic signature of T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia.

117.recognize_zh: 肋膜積液細胞塊中漂浮成團的大型漿母細胞樣（plasmablastic/immunoblastic）細胞，核仁明顯、細胞質雙染性，且無實體腫塊；同一病人皮膚有 Kaposi sarcoma 的紫紅結節與梭形細胞增生，病灶細胞呈 HHV8 LANA-1 顆粒狀核染色，指向 HIV 相關的原發性積液淋巴瘤（PEL）。
features: Effusion cell block: discohesive clusters of large atypical lymphoid cells floating in fibrinous/proteinaceous background
Large cells with round to irregular vesicular nuclei, prominent central nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm (plasmablastic/immunoblastic)
Admixed small reactive lymphocytes that remain negative on the tumor-cell markers
Tumor cells show strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining with one marker and nuclear staining (including a speckled, LANA-1-like pattern) with others; one marker is negative with heavy background
Skin biopsy: dermal spindle cell proliferation with slit-like vascular spaces, extravasated red cells and nuclear HHV8 LANA-1 positivity (Kaposi sarcoma)
Clinical photo: multiple violaceous macules/nodules on the scalp
117.describe_en: Pleural fluid cell block sections show clusters of large, discohesive neoplastic lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, set in a fibrinous background with scattered small lymphocytes. Immunostains demonstrate strong membranous/cytoplasmic positivity of the large cells for one marker, nuclear positivity for others including a granular LANA-1-type pattern, and negativity for a marker that shows only background staining; the specific antibodies are not labeled on the images. A concurrent skin biopsy shows a dermal spindle cell proliferation with slit-like vascular channels and nuclear HHV8 LANA-1 expression, corresponding to the violaceous scalp nodules. In an HIV-positive patient, findings are consistent with HHV8+/EBV+ primary effusion lymphoma with concurrent Kaposi sarcoma.

ddx.dx: Extracavitary/solid variant PEL or HHV8+ DLBCL, NOS
ddx.vs: PEL here is confined to the effusion without a solid mass, whereas HHV8+ DLBCL arises in lymph nodes/spleen, is usually EBV-negative and often expresses IgM lambda.
Plasmablastic lymphoma usually forms solid (often oral/GI) masses and is EBV+ but HHV8 LANA-1 negative.

ddx.dx: Fluid overload-associated large B-cell lymphoma (HHV8-negative effusion-based lymphoma)
ddx.vs: It occurs in elderly HIV-negative patients, usually retains CD20 and is HHV8-negative, unlike the LANA-1+ null-phenotype cells of PEL.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or mesothelial cells in effusion
ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive 3D clusters with keratin positivity, whereas PEL cells are discohesive, keratin-negative and express CD138/MUM1 with HHV8 LANA-1.

117.stain: H&E, IHC (incl. HHV8 LANA-1), clinical photo
captions: Clinical photo: violaceous macules and nodules on the scalp (Kaposi sarcoma)
Skin biopsy, H&E low power: dermal spindle cell proliferation with slit-like vascular spaces
Skin biopsy, H&E: interlacing spindle cells between collagen bundles
Skin biopsy, H&E high power: spindle-to-plump lesional cells with slit-like spaces containing red cells
Skin biopsy, HHV8 LANA-1 IHC: nuclear positivity in lesional spindle cells
Skin biopsy, HHV8 LANA-1 IHC high power: granular nuclear staining
Pleural fluid cell block, H&E: clusters of atypical lymphoid cells in fibrinous background
Cell block, H&E: dense aggregate of large discohesive tumor cells
Cell block, H&E high power: large plasmablastic cells with prominent nucleoli
Cell block, H&E high power: vesicular nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm
Cell block IHC (marker unlabeled): partial membranous staining of tumor cluster
Cell block IHC (marker unlabeled): strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining of large cells
Same marker, high power: ring-like membranous staining of tumor cells
Cell block IHC (marker unlabeled): nuclear staining in large cells, small lymphocytes negative
Same nuclear marker, higher power
Cell block IHC (marker unlabeled): tumor cells negative with heavy background staining
Same negative marker, higher power
Cell block nuclear stain in subset of large cells (likely HHV8 LANA-1 or EBER)
Cell block nuclear stain with speckled/granular pattern in most large cells (LANA-1-type)

53.recognize_zh: 淋巴結內有多個淡染、星芒狀至地圖狀的壞死區，中央為含嗜中性球與核碎片的微膿瘍（microabscess），周圍由呈柵欄狀排列的類上皮組織球包圍，這種「化膿性肉芽腫」型態強烈提示貓抓病（Bartonella henselae）。
features: Multiple pale, stellate to rounded necrotizing granulomas within the lymph node with a thickened fibrotic capsule
Central suppurative necrosis with numerous neutrophils and abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris (microabscesses)
Rim of palisading epithelioid histiocytes with elongated, bland oval nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Fibrinoid eosinophilic necrotic material at the interface between histiocyte rim and abscess
No caseation, no Langerhans giant cells and no sheets of plasmacytoid dendritic cells or crescentic histiocytes in the fields shown
53.describe_en: Lymph node biopsy shows partial effacement by multiple stellate and rounded necrotizing granulomas beneath a thickened, fibrotic capsule. At higher power, the lesions consist of central suppurative necrosis containing neutrophils and abundant karyorrhectic debris, surrounded by a palisading rim of epithelioid histiocytes. Caseous necrosis and multinucleated giant cells are not prominent, and no neoplastic infiltrate is identified. Special stains for AFB and fungi were reported negative, with bacilli demonstrated on Steiner silver stain. Findings are consistent with necrotizing suppurative granulomatous lymphadenitis compatible with cat scratch disease.

ddx.vs: Necrosis is karyorrhectic with crescentic histiocytes and plasmacytoid dendritic cells but characteristically lacks neutrophils and a palisading epithelioid granulomatous rim.

features: Multiple erythroid precursors with coarse blue siderotic granules arranged in a perinuclear ring
Granules encircle a third or more of the nuclear circumference in many cells

61365.describe_en: Prussian blue iron stain of a bone marrow aspirate shows numerous erythroid precursors containing coarse blue siderotic granules arranged in a perinuclear ring encircling at least one-third of the nucleus, diagnostic of ring sideroblasts. Other erythroid precursors show scattered non-ring granules, and granulocytic precursors are negative. Ring sideroblasts should be enumerated as a percentage of erythroid precursors (≥15%, or ≥5% with SF3B1 mutation, for MDS with ring sideroblasts). Findings are consistent with ring sideroblastic erythropoiesis; correlation with blast count, dysplasia, SF3B1 status, and reversible causes (alcohol, isoniazid, copper deficiency, zinc excess) is required.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts contain only a few fine granules scattered in the cytoplasm without a perinuclear ring.

ddx.dx: Reactive sideroblastic anemia (alcohol, isoniazid, copper deficiency)
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical ring sideroblasts; separated by history, reversibility, copper/zinc levels, and absence of SF3B1 mutation or clonal cytogenetics.
Presents early in life with microcytic hypochromic red cells, family history, and germline ALAS2/SLC25A38 mutation rather than acquired macrocytosis with dysplasia.
